tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī wān bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka saṅgu ru bh+ya: satwaṃ troṃ pad+ma rā ga s+yā ba mi nā bi ha ra tisma/ shu bhaṃ ka l+yā na bar+dhan+tu/ ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/1 dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ rgya gar skad du/ dhar+m+ma swā mi shrī wān saṅgu ru ma hā bhu mi paṇ+ḍu a nan+da gar+bha ye na ma: bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i chu gter las/ /dga' bzhi rang bzhin chu skyes rkang gnyis pa/ /snying po'i ze'u 'bru legs bshad dri bsung can/ /mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /skal bar ldan pa'i 'gro kun zhing sa la/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes sa bon legs btab te/ /nges don snying po'i 'bras bu smin mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs med smra ba'i seng ger gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshan rtog kun las rgyal ba ye shes thugs/ /dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin rtag tu bde ba'i nyams/ /brjod bral snying po'i don las mi g.yo ba'i/ /bde stong rol ba'i gter la gus pas 'dud/ /gang gi mkhyen pa lha lam ltar yangs pas/ /zab yang gsung rab kun gyi chu gter che/ /rmad byung yon tan rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar kun nas dad/ /mthu stobs mgon dang zur phud lnga pa'i zhal/ /mngon sum bstan nas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /legs par gsol bas khyod kyi 'phrin las kyis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di khyab la rjes yi rang / /de ltar bstod pas kun mkhyen khyod nyid kyis/ /bzhed gzhung zab dang rgya che'i chos rgyun rnams/ /dus mthar skyes pa'i brgyud 'dzin blo gros can/ /skal bzang bdag gis rab tu rgyas byed shog /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ dpal ldan brtse ba chen po la legs par bstod pa'i skabs te dang po'o//

༈ //rgya gar skad du/ s+d+yi ra tsakra/ ā tsar+ya rat+na se na ma: bod skad du/ bstan pa'i 'khor lo slob dpon rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ldan dbang phyug thugs rje'i thig le las/ /dpag med bsod nams mthu las bskrun pa'i sku/ /rtse mo'i ye shes la sogs mthar phyin pa'i/ /rkang gnyis tshul 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /gang sku mthong byed dbang pos mthong na dga'/ /gang gsung thos pa tsam gyi thos don ldan/ /gang thugs dran pas zag med dran pa brnyed/ /kun gyi bstod la bdag kyang bstod par bgyi/ /mgon khyod bltams tshe 'phags yul sgo them la/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi snyan tshig yi ger btab/ /e ma gzhan las phul byung ngo mtshar gyi/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho'i gter la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya kun la thogs med blo rgyas kyang / /'jig rten drangs phyir rig gnas kun la sbyangs/ /de phyir bcu bdun lo la'ang gaṅgā tshun/ /mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun bde stong chen po'i rnam rol las/ /mkhas pa'i bya bas bstan pa rgyas mdzad nas/ /bkod pa gnyis kyi dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /skyes bu'i gtsug rgyan de la kun nas dad/ /de ltar bstod pas bsod nams rin chen dbang / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo mdzes byas te/ /'gro ba kun gyi srid dang zhi ba yi/ /dpal yon bskyed pa'i byed por bdag gyur cig /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs la legs par bstod pa'i skabs ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ yo ge shwa ra badz+ra dha ra bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka rat+na kirti dh+wa dza ye na ma: bod skad du/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs kyi gtsang chab las/ /legs 'khrungs chu skyes grags pa'i dri bsung can/ /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab las rgyal mtshan ma yis/

/skal bzang bung ba'i re 'dod skong la 'dud/ /gang gis 'dren mchog man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ngom par gsol bas tha mal snang zhen kun/ /dag par rab 'byams bde stong rol par shar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyan la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi ting 'dzin zab mo'i nus pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul du mas gzhan gyi dregs pa bcom/ /gzugs med rnams kyis zhabs la mngon sum gtugs/ /grub pa'i khyu mchog khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bla ma nyid yin par/ /nges par dgongs pas man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /slar yang gsol ba de la bdag cag dad/ /re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /bde ba can dang byang phyogs gser mdog can/ /rim gyis bgrod nas skye ba gsum pa la/ /kun mkhyen brnyes pa'i tshul la rjes yi rang / /de ltar bstod pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng kun khyab pas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad khyod lta bur/ /ring po ma thogs bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ dpal ldan grags pa'i rgyal mtshan can la legs par bstod pa'i skabs ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa tsī ra:bhu mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi ta nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye na ma: bod skad du/ zur phud lnga pa sa skya pa mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes me long thugs rje'i rgyun las 'khrungs/ /gzhon nu nyid nas sngon gyi bag chags sad/ /nges par 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs can zhes/ /skye bo kun gyi kha na rgyu la 'dud/ /paṇa chen khyod nyid skye ba bcu phrag gnyis/ /lnga yis lhag pa'i tshe rab thams cad du/ /smra ba'i rgyal po'i nye bar bskyangs pa'i mthus/ /chos kun gzigs pa de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mgon khyod shes bya'i gnas la thogs med ces/

/snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzin ma'i khyon gang bas/ /mu stegs ngan pa'i rgol ba lhags pa'i tshe/ /kun kyang tshar bcad rjes su bzung la 'dud/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar gtam gyi rgyud bskul nas/ /yangs pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur rgyal po yi/ /mgon khyod gus pa chen po'i nyer bsten nas/ /mtha' med bstan pa'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal 'jigs bral yab sras kyis/ /khyod thugs bde stong rol par byin brlabs cing / /myur ba nyid du mngon par 'tshang rgya zhes/ /rmad byung lung bstan brnyed la kun nas dad/ /de ltar bstod pa'i legs byas bsod nams kyis/ /bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma nang don rig /kun la 'jigs med blo yi mig thob ste/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma ra ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la legs par bstod pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ surba dzi na:ār+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye na ma: bod skad du/ sngon gyi rgyal ba 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ut+pal sngo ldan rigs las sprul pa'i sku/ /blo gros gter chen chos char 'bebs pa'i gsung / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /bzang po'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung rnam thar bsam yas kyi/ /skyes chen dam pa kun las mngon par 'phags/ /de phyir 'jig rten khams 'dir 'gro kun la/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa zhes su grags la 'dud/ /mgon po khyod kyi 'dzam gling phyogs kha gsum/ /dbang du mdzad de bod 'bangs bde la bkod/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal yang zil gnon pa'i/ /bsod nams bye ba'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /dmigs med brtse bas 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /nus pas rdzu 'phrul bkod pa sna tshogs ston/

/kun gyi 'gran zla bral la kun nas dad/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor zla med kyis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir gang ba khyod kyi drin/ /bsam gyin snying nas dad pas rjes yi rang / /de ltar bstod pas gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i blo gros rab rgyas te/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ /brgyud 'dzin skyes bu'i ljongs 'di khyab gyur cig /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las/ dpal ldan 'phags pa'i zhabs la legs par bstod pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ tshul 'di rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma rnams la rmongs dad tsam min par/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa'i blo gros can/ /mang du thos pa bdag gis legs par sbyar/ /zang zing nor gyis dregs pa'i skye bo la/ /col chung rnams kyi legs legs mgrin bsgrigs nas/ /sa gsum 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa zhes/ /tshul min bstod pa de la ngo mtshar ci/ /mtshan tsam dran pa'i sdig pa'i dpung 'joms shing / /rnam thar zhugs na 'di phyi'i bde ba ster/ /gang gis mthong thos dran reg don ldan pa/ /sa skya'i rje btsun las gzhan 'ga' ma mchis/ /de lta'i skyes chen rnams la dad pa'i blos/ /pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba spel ba'i mthus/ /dus 'dir chos mthun don rnams mthar phyin nas/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bshes gnyen yongs su 'dzin pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can gyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ kā la du ti zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo/

shai ṣa:zhes pa dgun smad kyi dus kyi/ mā gha zhes pa mchu zla ba'i dmar cha'i tshes la gu ṇa rat+na ka ra: shrī wan bhu mi'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gzim chung bde ba can du rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan yid la dran zhing / mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas legs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du skyes chen dam pa de dag gi thugs brtse ba chen pos skad cig kyang 'bral ba med par rjes su bzung nas shā sa na sa twaṃ hi tā+o bha wan+tu/ kā l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu/ sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje btsun gong ma lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/2 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ kun nas mdzes pa'i zhal dkyil zla ltar rgyas/ /dga' bzhi'i mthar son lhan skyes ye shes dang / /nges don snying po'i skal ldan grol mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun brtse ba chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs med gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /dhīḥyig las 'khrungs 'jam dpal mi yi zol/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dge mtshan gyi/ /dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas tha mal rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas rang byung ye shes brnyes/ /nam yang bde stong rol pa'i dus 'da' ba'i/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la kun nas dad/ /bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma nang don rig /kun la gang gi blo yis thogs pa med/ /zur phud lnga pa ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /sa skya paṇa chen zhabs la phyag bgyi 'o/ /gang thugs zab rgyas chos kyi chu gter te/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor 'khor los bsgyur ba bzhin/ /rmad byung yon tan du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/

/dpal ldan 'phags par dwangs ba'i yid kyis 'dud/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang sgyu ma'i sku/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan yab sras brgyud par bcas/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ /kye ma lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang las 'phro bzang po'i bag chags sad/ /skyon med bla ma mchog gi brtse bas bskyangs/ /skyes stobs blo yis shes bya'i gnas kun rig /mkhas pa'i las la 'jigs med spobs pa thob/ /de lta mod kyi bdud rigs byin brlabs kyis/ /lhag bsam gzhan phan mthu bral kho bo la/ /mkhyen zhing brtse la nus pa gter mnga' ba/ /bslu med rnams kyis rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /mchog tu 'phel ba'i nus pa stsal du gsol/ /nam yang shes bya'i mtha' la thug med cing / /le lo rnam g.yeng 'gal rkyen cher mang bas/ /gsung rab phal cher sbyong 'dod yul du lus/ /phyin chad de kun mthar phyin mdzod 'dzin shog /thog med bag chags 'thug pos gsal rig 'di/ /bde stong ngang du cung zad gnas ma nus/ /da ni bla ma'i thugs rjes snang srid 'di/ /lhan skyes ye shes rol par 'char gyur cig /'khrul zad gong ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab pas/ /chos mthun don rnams 'bad med mthar phyin te/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog bde mchog bla ma brgyud pa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang du zab don nyams len gyi dpyad rgya dam mu nas rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan yid la dran pa'i rkyen gyis myur bar bris pa 'dis skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du skyes chen dam pa de dag gi thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gong bstod bzhugs/3gong na mo ā nan+da gar+bha ye/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid de nyid rtogs dang legs gzigs pa/ /gang de gnyis pa rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdzes shing legs nas brnyed cing legs thob rab bsgom pas/ /grol nas bgrod de zhi zhing gsum par 'gro bar shog /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myur bar bsdebs pa'o/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mkhas pa rnams kyis don 'di rtogs par 'gyur la/ blun pos 'bad kyang dka'o/ /bshes gnyen mkhas pa rnams kyi tshig 'bru 'di rnams la 'grel pa re mdzod/ mtshungs med bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga la legs par bstod pa 'di rdzogs so/ /'dis bstan pa la phan par gyur cig yi ge pa yang nga rang gis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gong ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kun 'jug zhes bya ba bzhugs/3'og na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi rang babs la nges shes bskyed de/ rje btsun bslu med rnams la blo lhing khel gyi mos gus dung dung pa dang bcas ngag tu/ rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya'i bla chen rje/ /yab sras gsum dang chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag kyang khyed 'drar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes yid rtse gcig pa'i brgya stong la sogs par gsol ba btab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags mngon gyur du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi lag tu skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rjes rje btsun gong ma lnga'i sku 'dra so so'i phyag nas zhugs pa rnams dang /

sa skya bka' 'bum tshar du ma zhig byung ba rnams la blta rtog bgyis tshe gong ma rnams la dad pa'i spu long che cher g.yos nas bris pa 'dis bdag cag rnams kyi don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /kā l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bstod pa 'phags mchog ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/4 na maḥ shrī dharmā swa mi ye/ 'phags mchog yon tan du ma 'byung ba'i gnas/ /na len+d+ra dang chos mtshungs gdan sa cher/ /rang lo brgyad gnyis gsum gyi ma lon pa'i/ /dus der shar ri'i rtse la bir+wa'i sku/ /rab brjid skyil krung chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /rab mdzes sngon po'i 'od la rgyab brten pa/ /rab gsal dbang po'i dwangs ma'i sgo ru shar/ /rab dga' la sogs mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /yongs 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma gus bsten nas/ /'gro mang chos kyi bya bas skyong ba la/ /dus rnams kun du khyod kyis legs gzigs phyir/ /mtshan don ldan pa de la bdag cag 'dud/ /rnam mang shes bya'i tshogs la rab mkhas pas/ /rnam dag 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur cing / /rnam 'dren khyod kyis bsgrub la rab brtson pas/ /rnam mkhyen mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung la 'dud/ /me sbrul lo la so ma pu rir 'khrungs/ /sa 'brug lo la grub pa'i pha rol son/ /bstan la phan par dgongs nas da lta yang / /so wa na thar bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /ngan pa'i spyod la brtson pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /ngan smra mu stegs phal cher zil gyi mnan/ /ngan rtog thams cad dge la sbyor bar mdzad/ /ngan pa'i mtshan gyis bstan pa spel la 'dud/ /skye ba du mar yang yang sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir blo gros gsal ba bdag gi rigs/ /brgyud pa phal cher mgon pos rjes bzung ba/ /de phyir bdag la'ang brtse phyir kun nas 'dud/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal rnam gnyis mchod pas mchod/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rje yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing rtag bzhugs 'tshal/

/dge ba 'khor gsum shes rab ldan pas bsngo/ /drang don rnal 'byor dbang phyug nam mkhar mthong / /kun rdzob rnal 'byor dbang phyug rang gi sems/ /nges don de yang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /bral phyir brjod bral ngang las g.yo ba med/ /de lta'i mthar thug lta ba myur rtogs shing / /rnam mang tshe yi bar gcod kun zhi nas/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i rgyud phyug ste/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lus mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di ni shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sa bcu'i byang sems chen po bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul pa bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i drung las gsung ngag nos dus/ sngar gyi rmi lam dran nas rang lo bco brgyad lon tshe dben gnas gling dga' bde ba can du bris po'o/ /kā l+ya na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi sgo nas bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/5 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza bir+wa pa ye/ gang gi mtshan tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i bya ba nus pa'i 'phrin las can/ /stobs kyi mgon po dpal ldan chos skyong la/ /mdzad pa drug gi sgo nas bstod par bgyi/ /sku mdog sngo nag zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i/ skyil krung bcas/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis rang gi gdan mnan cing / /g.yon pas 'jigs rung sdigs mdzub drag po yi/ /gaṅgā gyen la ldog mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog dmar nag rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /phyag g.yon rab mdzes thod pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis sdigs mdzub legs mdzad te/ /nyi ma gting par 'dzin mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog sngo nag skyil sems dpa'i/ krung bcas te bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /dpal ldan sa skyar zab dang rgya che ba'i/

/chos kyi 'khor lo skor mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog sngo nag skyil krung mtho skrong nge ba/ bar bcas/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis rang gi gdan mnan cing / /g.yon pas khu tshur g.yon pa'i pus steng bzhag /gser 'gyur rtsi yis 'khrul mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog sngo nag zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i/ skyil krung bcas/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis gdan steng rab mnan cing / /g.yas pa dpral bar thal mo phyar mdzad ste/ /mu stegs lha rten dges mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog sngo nag phyag gnyis rtse gsum gyis/ /phyag g.yas thugs ka'i thad kar rtse sprad sbyar/ /zhabs gnyis ming med brtsegs zhabs g.yon pa'i srin mdzub g.yas pa'i srin mdzub kyis mnan pa'o/ /pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /mu stegs ngan pa gnon mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /rnam 'gyur drug gi sgo nas bstod pa yi/ /bsod nams gang des bdag sogs shes rgyud la/ /bde chen ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig /mgon po gang gis brtse chen sa skya pa/ /dri med brgyud par bcas pa rjes bzung zhing / /de bzhin bdag la'ang byin rlabs da dung yang / /byang chub bar du 'bral med skyabs su gsol/ /de lta'i bdag la nges shes ma mchis kyang / /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma yi/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rjes bzung zhes/ /zhal lung thob phyir 'di la som nyi med/ /e ma chos kun sems kyi spyod yul ste/ /rmi lam dag tu sangs rgyas zhal mthong yang / /de nyid sangs rgyas dngos su thag bcad na/ /de 'drar 'gyur zhes bdag gi mgon des gsungs/ /gsung de brjed med yang yang snying nas dran/ /dran pas chos kun lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /shar ba de yang bde stong rol pa'i ngang / /de lta'i nyams rtogs rgyud la skye bar shog /'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong bi ru pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung zab dang rgya che'i dam chos rnams/

/gang gi byin rlabs brgyud pas 'phel slad du/ /bdag gi rigs brgyud rgyun 'chad med par shog /bla ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs rje yi/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi sgo nas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo ba de nyid dang / spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpal stobs kyi mgon po bi ru pa'i rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bhaṭ+ṭā ra ga yo gī shwa ra shrī ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ma ṇi ha ra bi tsa k+ṣa ṇa rā ya swa la kri ta nā ma bi ha ra tisma/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal thugs rje chen po la bstod pa nor bu'i do shal mkhas rnams dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/6 bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka yo gī shwa ra shrī ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ma ṇi ha ra bi tsa k+ṣa ṇa rā ya swa la kri ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal thugs rje chen po la bstod pa nor bu'i do shal mkhas rnams dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba/ rje btsun rdo rje rnon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen kun la brtse ba kun gyi mgon/ /dga' bzhi dga' bde rgya mtsho'i dga' ston can/ /snying po'i snying po mchog gi snying rjes 'doms/

/sa chen sa bcu'i mthar son sa brnyes rgyal/ /kun gzigs dbang po kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /dga' bde'i 'byung gnas dga' ba rgya mtsho'i gsungs/ /snying rje'i dpal dang snying stobs spras pa'i sku/ /sa skyong gtsug rgyan sa gsum bla ma rgyal/ /kun gyi snga rol kun nas sangs rgyas kyang / /dga' bzhi'i 'gro kun dga' mgur brtson pa'i phyir/ /snying po'i don ston snying rje'i gzhan dbang can/ /sa dgu las rgyal sa kun mnga' bdag rgyal/ /kun gzigs mngon par dga' ba gser mdog can/ /dga' ldan la sogs zhing khams mtha' yas par/ /snying rje chen pos sprul pa kun 'gyed pa/ /sa mchog bcu gsum khyod kyis mngon du mdzad/ /kun mkhyen khyod ni mkhas pa kun gyi bla/ /dga' chen khyod ni skal bzang dga' ba'i bshes/ /snying stobs ldan khyod snying po ston pa'i mchog /sa yi dbang phyug sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon/ /kun la chags dang chags bral mtha' spangs kyang / /dga' bzhi mdzes ma'i bzhin la lhag par chags/ /snying rje stong pa'i ro yi rtag gang ba/ /dpal ldan dang po'i mgon po longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun gyi rigs bdag rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dga' chen btsun mo'i tshogs bcas pho brang gi /snying po dam par bde chen gar gyis rtsen/ /sa lam kun rdzogs bde gshegs rnams kyi rje/ /kun la kun tu kun nas mtshungs med kyang / /dga' chen dga' mchog dga' bde'i dpal ster phyir/ /snying rjes snying po'i snying po dam pa ston/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'gro ba'i mgon/ /kun mkhyen ral pa'i nags rol gdong lnga khyed/ /dga' ma'i bdag po'i rgyal mtshan mtho bsnyil nas/ /snying rje chen po'i gad rgyang bye ba yis/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i ri dwags dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /kun mkhyen byed pos kun nas rim gror mdzad/ /dga' byed sprin zhon dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis bstod/ /snying stobs can rnams snying nas gus mchod pa/

/sa gsum che dgu sa chen khyod zhabs bsten/ /kun gsal khyon du pad+ma'i gnyen dang ni/ /dga' ba'i tshal du mtho ris mgon po ltar/ /snying rje chen po zlos gar grangs med pa/ /sa gsum 'di na khyod ni rnam par rtsen/ /kun du gsung rab rigs dang grol bar smra /dga' chen rgyud sde bzhi yi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ /snying po'i man ngag bye ba phrag brgya'i gter/ /sa steng 'di na chos kyi dbang phyug che/ /kun mkhyen grub rig dbang po dam pa khyed/ /dga' ba'i dpal dang sbyin pa'i dpal la sogs/ /snying po'i don ston sprul pa bsam yas pa/ /sa kun legs bshad snang bas khyab par mdzad/ /kun gsal rab yang dpal ldan sa skya ru/ /dga' ma'i bdag las 'khon pa'i rigs 'od 'bar/ /snying rje chen po'i rta ljang gis drangs te/ /sa gsum gsal ba'i nyin byed phyogs 'dir shar/ /kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dbyangs bla ma yi/ /dga' ba'i zhal gyi pad+ma las 'ongs pa/ /snying po mchog gi gdams pa'i sbrang rtsi rnams/ /sa skya pa zhes grags 'bar khyed la babs/ /kun gyi ma mo chos mngon rgya mtsho las/ /dga' gus dad pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yos nas/ /snying po'i zhabs kyi zhabs pad bsten pa'i phyir/ /sa mchog ngur smrig gnas su bde blag bgrod/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i chos mngon rgya mtsho dang / /dga' ldan mi pham mgon po'i chos lnga dang / /snying po sdom gnyis rab 'byed sde brgyad dang / /sa sde lnga sogs gzhung mang legs gsan nas/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen blo brtan zhabs/ /dga' ldan mgon po 'phags mchog thogs med kyi/ /snying po'i dgongs don ma lus thugs chud de/ /sa der grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po bsgrengs/ /kun mkhyen gsungs yang dpyad gsum ma dag na/ /dga' dad tsam gyis 'jug par bya min pas/ /snying po rnam dag rigs pa nyid yin pas/ /sa steng smra ba'i seng chen khyod dgongs nas/ /kun mkhyen smra ba'i gtsug rgyan lo tsā ba/

/dga' mgur bsten pa'i sras mchog rnam bzhi las/ /snying po dbu tshad rig pa'i bka' babs mchog /sa steng smra ba'i khyung chen de bsten nas/ /kun las btus dang sde bdun 'grel par bcas/ /dga' mgur smra ba'i spobs pa brnyes pa ni/ /snying stobs mtshungs med nags kyi gdong lnga pa/ /sa steng nyal ba'i dbus na rol ba bzhin/ /kun gsal lung rigs mig gi rgyud sde yis/ /dga' ma'i bzhin ras mdzes pa mi mthong med/ /snying po'i don la thabs shes lag 'khyud na/ /sa lam bsgrod la dka' ba med gzigs nas/ /kun gzigs dbang po'i gsang mdzod rgyud sde rnams/ /dga' chen snyem ma'i bdag dang dbyer med pa/ /snying rje chen po rat+na kirti zhes/ /sa steng grags pa rab dkar de la gsan/ /kun gsal bu mo kun gyi go skabs 'byed/ /dga' ma'i bdag po dga' mar sred byed ltar/ /snying po'i zhabs 'ongs snying po'i rgyud gsum rnams/ /sa kun mdzes byed sa chen khyod kyis gsan/ /kun rig mtshan ldan rje btsun stobs kyi mgon/ /dga' chen grub dbang 'bar ba'i mtha' can las/ /snying po'i gdams pa lam skor dgu la sogs/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po khyod kyis mnos/ /kun gyi yang rtse dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom/ /dga' chen mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /snying por gyur pa'i gdams pa rab 'byams rnams/ /sa la gnas pa blo gros grags las mnos/ /kun gyi rnam 'dren dar ma rgyal mtshan las/ /dga' chen 'dus pa rnam gnyis man ngag bcas/ /snying po'i lam zab dpag tu med pa rnams/ /sa skyong gtsug rgyan khyod kyis gus pas blang / /kun mkhyen gnas lnga rig pa pad+ma shrī/ /dga' bzhi'i thugs ldan ye shes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /snying po'i grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs/ /sa gsum grags pa'i paṇa grub mang du bsten/ /kun gyi bla ma rje btsun a skyabs zhabs/ /dga' chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod lcags thang pa/

/snying po'i don mkhas dpal ldan me dig sogs/ /sa gsum mdzes rgyan dam pa mang du bsten/ /kun gzigs dbang po dpal chen bi rū pa/ /dga' chen nag po kā yas+ṭha pa'i zhabs/ /snying rje'i gdugs dkar 'dzin pa ko ṭa li/ /sa mos mdog 'dzin bi na sa par bcas/ /kun gsal dbyings nas mngon sum gzigs pa'i tshe/ /dga' chen bla med rgyud sde bdun cu gnyis/ /snying por gyur pa'i zab chos rnam bzhi sogs/ /sa skya pa zhes rab grags khyod la gdams/ /kun nas ngo mtshar rnam thar bye ba'i gter/ /dga' ba'i mtshan can gang gi mdzad pa'i tshul/ /snying po mdo tsam brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /sa skya'i bla chen ci 'drar bdag kyang shog /kun gyi mgon po khyod kyi gdung gi rigs/ /dga' ba'i ming can bdag las cher 'phel nas/ /snying po'i mchog gyur sa skya'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /sa gsum khyab cing srid mthar gnas par shog /kun nas yid mthun bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dga' bde'i ngang nas tshe rab mthar phyin te/ /snying po'i don mchog phyi ma lhan cig tu/ /sa lam ma lus bde ba can bsgrod shog /kun gzigs bla ma mchog gi thugs rje dang / /dga' zhing spro ba'i dad pa rnam gsum gyis/ /snying po gsol ba 'debs par bdag brtson na/ /sa skya'i bla chen thugs rjes 'bral med skyobs/ /zhes rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal thugs rje chen po la bstod pa nor bu'i do shal mkhas rnams dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yang rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i gang gi blo gros kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su gang ba'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po grags pa rdo rje'i gsung rab la gtso bor bsten zhing kha skongs su 'os pa'i tshigs bcad du mas kyang mdzes par byas te rang gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bzhir son pa/

byi ba'i lo gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba'i tshes la/ dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang / yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa phul du phyin pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis gzab nas bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma 'bral med bde ba can skyes nas/ /phyin chad las nyon skye sgo chod gyur cig /kal+yā na war+dhan tu// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rjes btsun chen po dang / chos rje khu dbon/ dpal ldan bla ma rnams la bstod pa'i rgya gzhung rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs/7 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /skyes chen rnams la 'phags yul paṇ+ḍi tas/ /bstod pa'i tshogs rnams deng dus dpyod ldan rnams/ /dang 'dod dad pa bskyed phyir 'dir bshad bya/ /rgya gar skad du/ mahā paṇ+ḍi ta kirti dh+wa dza stod tra/ bod skad du/ mkhas pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rgya mtshor tshig gi me tog snyan tshig ze'u 'brus rnam par spud pa'i bstod dbyangs kyis/ /phreng ba spel legs dag gi rab brgyus dri med chun pos gang gi mgul pa brgyan gyur pa'i/ /blo gsal stong gi khyod kyi rang bzhin bsngags par gyur mod de lta na'ang bdag rmongs pa/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis ci ltar nus bzhin cung zad brjod la mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /sgyu ma'i phreng ba'i las tshul gyis rmongs gang zhig srid pa'i chu gter du/ /bsod nams gru char blo gros lus bying bshes gnyen gnyan pas dor ba yi/ /lus can rnams la byang chub yan lag drug phrag gsum gyi gzhung lugs kyi/

/rlung drag rtsub pa'i rba rlabs 'thor bas dam pa'i go 'phang pha rol son/ /grub pa dri med dge slong dge 'dun rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom brtson dang / /brtul zhugs grub pa blo gros gsal ldan rtog ge'i dbang po'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /khyod kyi zhabs rdul rnyog pa med la rnam par kun gtugs de slad du/ /gangs can 'di na 'gran zlas dben par mngon du gyur bzhin kho bos 'tshal/ /dam pa khyod kyi legs bshad bsod nams sprin/ /dge ba'i lo thog 'phel ba'i char rgyun can/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zab mo stong sgrogs pas/ /skal ldan blo gros gnyid log rnam par bskul/ /khyed kyi chos bsgrubs gzhung mang 'chad pa dang / /legs bshad rtsom dang kha ton rgya che dang / /ting 'dzin dri med 'khor lo mchod pa'i tshul/ /rnam dag lta ba spyod lam dag pa dang / /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshul la nyer gnas pa/ /khyed kyi kun spyod de dag thams cad la/ /rgol ba gzhan gyis kun nas mi rdzi ba/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la sngon ma mthong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rin chen rang bzhin dkon mchog gzhal med dpal ldan gtsug lag khang chen du/ /dga' ston dam pa sa gsum rab grags chags bral khyed dpal 'byor pa las byung rab dge zhing / /thub pa'i sku gzugs rab tu dag pa rin chen las bsgrubs kun nas mdzad pa rgya che ba/ /khyod mtshungs ma mchis de slad bdag blo spro ba'i chu klung dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rnam par 'phel/ /bsod nams dri med zla zer zil gnon byas pa'i 'od zer rab spros pas/ /nam mkha'i zla ba rnyog can de ni khyod kyi dpal 'bar ma bzod de/ /gzugs brnyan tshul gyis rgya mtsho'i nang du 'jug par 'dod pa nyid snyam du/ /bdag gi blo gros de ltar sems pas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur/ /gdung brgyud dri med yon tan rgya che ba/ /blo gros mtshungs med mkhas pas nyer bsten cing / /gzhan la phan dgongs phongs pa'i bsti gnas pa/

/mdzad pa rgya che nye bar zhi ba can/ /khyod mtshungs ma lags de slad dpe bral ba/ /khyed la rnam kun bstod par nus ma lags/ /'on kyang cung zad bstod 'di spro ba dang / /dge slong mkhas pa byang chub 'od zer gyi/ /rjes gnang thob nas de la gang gnang ba/ /de bzhin 'dir ni bdag gis gsal bar sbyar/ /mchog tu rmad byung grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /mkhas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal bdag gis/ /legs par bstod la bsod nams gang yod pa/ /des ni 'gro kun bla ma la gus shog /bdag nyid chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po su ga ta shrīs sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhas pa de nyid dang / shākya'i dge bsnyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ ā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra stod tra aṣ+ṭa na maḥ bod skad du/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi kun spyod legs par sbyangs pas sngon dge las grub rnam pa kun du dpe bral ba/ /rigs zla blo gros nor ldan gzhon nu'i tshe na'ang rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la phul byung ba/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan khyod lta'i blo gsal rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas sa steng 'di na rnyed dka' ste/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs rdul reg khyod gangs can 'di na mkhas pa kun gyi mig gcig yin/ /sgra yi tshul mkhas rtog ge'i gzhung la ma rmongs shing / /sdebs sbyor legs sbyangs snyan ngag rtsom la thogs pa med/ /gsang sngags rig cing shes bya kun sbyangs blo gros can/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'gro la ring du gnas par shog /paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shrīs mkhas pa chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rdzogs so// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ saṅgu ru dharmā rā dza stod dra na ma: bod skad du/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rab rgyas rta yi dpung gi rba rlabs phreng ba legs mtho zhags pa ral gri mdung rnon gyi/ /chu la rgyu ba rab mang 'jigs rung rnga chen sgra ldan hor zhes bya ba dus mtha' yi/ /chu gter 'di ni mtha' dag mkhas pa'i bla ma gang gi zur mig rol pas 'jig rten rnams/ /zhi slad rab mchog rgyas pa'i tshul la zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal po de ni rgyal gyur cig nub phyogs bod kyi ri la shin tu dri med 'char ba thob cing shar phyogs dag gi yul/ /rim pas mnan pa gang gi rmongs pa las skyes shin tu rab rgyas mun pa bcom byas nas/ /sems can byang chub grong khyer phyin slad chos gsung 'od zer drwa bas mtshungs med sangs rgyas lam/ /rab tu gsal mdzad chos kyi rgyal po mchog gi 'od zer 'phreng ldan de ni rgyal gyur cig /gang gi mtha' dag skye bo rnams la phan pa bgyis slad rgyun du rab mchog rgyal po yi/ /khyu mchog sems can dag pas bstan gang rdzogs ldan la ni rkang bzhi pa dang gsum ldan la/ /rkang pas dman dang gnyis ldan dag la rkang zung gis rgyu gcod la rkang gcig ldan pa can/ /gang gi sa la rdzogs ldan bzhin du rgyu mdzad chos kyi rgyal po de ni rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig 'jig rten dag na sa gzhi 'byung po 'dzin byed nyi ma dag kyang 'jig rten ni/ /snang ba dag dang ldan par byed cing sprin rnams char pa 'bebs byed rlung yang rgyun du g.yo/ /zla ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni rnam par spro byed nam mkha' go skabs 'byed la rab tu dpa'/ /de bzhin chos kyi rgyal po zol med snying rje sems can kun la rab tu 'jug par byed/ /bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan ngag mkhan chen po lak+ṣi ka ras sbyar ba'o/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa gshong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o/

/rgya gar skad du/ dharma swā mi shrī man saṅgu ru puṇ+ye dh+wa dza shrī bha dra stod tra na maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ swasti/ ji ltar rab gsal nyi ma de ni sa rnams kun la rtag tu mdzes pa nyid/ /de ltar gzi brjid rab gsal khyod ni phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'od zer dag gis 'gebs/ khyod ni phyogs bcur rab grags chos kyi bla ma gang du 'du ba che yang stsol/ kun mkhyen kun gyi bla ma chos kyi rang bzhin bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /sa 'og rtsa bar rab rgyu thang la gnas pa lag 'gro'i dbang po'i spyi bo'i steng du rab 'phro zhing / /zhabs kyi pad rdul dag la myur ba myur bar rab mchod lan gcig min par kun gyi lus kyis 'dud/ /lha ltar zhi la drang srong dang mtshungs sdig pa nag po'i lus kyis kun du g.yogs pa mtha' dag rnams/ /gsal bar mdzad pa de yi mche ba'i rtse la mdzes par bzung ba'i mdzad spyod mthong ba'i bzhad gad 'byin/ /bzhed pas dpal rnams do shal du/ /mgrin par byed pa dag dang mtshungs/ /khyod kyi gsung rgyun gtsug nor bus/ /ngo mtshar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan spyod/ /chos kyi rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ wa ra na sa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bid+ya ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos yul dbus kyi snying po lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o/ /de ltar sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams la/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi tas/ /bstod pa'i tshogs rnams lhan cig bsgrigs pa yi/ /bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya'i gsung rab 'di/ /dus mthar skyes pa'i brgyud 'dzin blo gros can/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /chos med sa skya pa des rtsol bas bsdebs/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/

/dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don rnams/ /sngar bzhin 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje btsun rin po che'i gsol 'debs skad gnyis sbyar ba ngo mtshar snang ba bzhugs/8 na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ sarba dhar+m+man ta twa chos rnams kun gyi de nyid gzigs/ pā sh+ya ṭa/ man+t+ra sā ga ra sa ra gaḥ gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ badz+ra dha ra sarba swā mi: rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rje/ kirti dh+wa dza ya pra me/ grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ zhes gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yi ge gnyis zung ldan du bsdebs pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi gdan sa chen po'i phyag dpe khang rnams kyi khrod na bzhugs pa legs par btus pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu/ bde legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba dā oṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// ༈ //'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/9 oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ bla ma dang thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug po/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i mchod/ /gsol 'debs bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa bcu drug la shes nas dad pa thob pa sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub phug cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong dang nye ba'i sa'i cha rdo khang zhes bya ba'i khang brtsegs su rang lo bcu bzhi'i dus dpal sa skya'i bde mchog pho brang du rdo rje phur ba'i bsnyen pa byas dus kyi rmi lam dran nas yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod don kun 'grub bzhugs/10na mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gu ru a nan+da badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra na maḥbla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi rje/ /sa skyar 'khrungs shing rig gnas lnga la mkhas/ /shākya shrī'i sa paṇa mtshan du gsol/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan khyed la bdag 'dud do/ /khyod ni sngon chad gzugs sku'i tshul bzung ste/ /skye ba gcig bzung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i dpal/ /'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa gang la yang / /thogs pa med pa 'jam mgon dag dang mtshungs/ /shākya'i rgya po'i bstan pa dri med la/ /log par spyod pa'i mu stegs rgyal po 'joms/ /bstan pa'i sgron me chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i rtser/ /dga' ba'i tshal ltar ze'u 'bru 'khyil pa'i dbus/ /rgyal po'i tshul gyi dhīḥyig dmar ser las/ /mtshan dpes brgyan zhing legs 'khrungs de la 'dud/ /gangs can khrod 'dir 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs/ /rig gnas kun la thogs pa med pa'i dpal/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes/ /gangs can 'gran zla bral ba de la 'dud/ /kye ma kyi hud khyed kyi sku ma mthong / /las ngan bsags pas gsung mchog ma thos kyang / /snying nas yid ches dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /de ltar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs chos rje la/ /snying nas thal sbyar gus pas gsol btab pas/ /bdag gis smon pa'i bsam pa 'di dag kun/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes legs par 'grub par shog /bdag ni rje btsun khyed kyi thugs rje yi/ /myur du ngur smṛg gos kyis mdzes byas shing / /bslab gsum 'dul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan nas/

/rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin ltar 'byed par shog /khyad par rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dri med la/ /thos pa legs dpyad de don rtogs pa dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom sogs kun la thogs med par/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /bdag ni rab tu byung ba nas brtsams te/ /ji srid tshe 'di'i snang ba ma nub bar/ /khrims la gnas shing thos bsam sgom la sogs/ /rtag tu mi nyams gong nas gong 'phel shog /bdag ni skye ba kun du dal 'byor gyis/ /lus 'di blangs shing chos dang mjal ba dang / /khyad par ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes byas shing / /bslab gsum 'dul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan shog /bdag gi gtso byas mar gyur sems can kun/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar ma nus rnams/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes myur du sgrol bar shog /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bdag gi snying nas dad pas gsol btab pas /tshe 'dir las ngan sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /phyi ma sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni mkhon gyi rigs can kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo bcu bzhi'i thog 'jig rten la snying po med par nges shing / rab byung yang myur du bsgrub par 'dod pa dang / sdom gsum 'dzin pa la tshig don rnams dbye sogs nges shing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob te legs par sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni kun dga' don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na rje btsun nyid kyis bzod par bzhes shig bla ma kun 'dus sa skya paṇa chen dang / /yi dam kun 'dus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / /chos srung kun 'dus pu tra chen po yis/ /don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis dam pa stsol/ /sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing zhes bya ba bzhugs/11

rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya sid+dhi shwa ra mañdzu gho ṣa pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing zhes bya ba/ smra ba rnams kyi mchog thams cad mkhyen pa la gus pas 'dud par bgyi'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gzugs/ /mchog dman gdul bya'i mig gi me long la/ /ma sgrib so sor 'char ba dngos po'i gshis/ /khyab bdag mgon po dbang po'i mtshan can rgyal/ /gang gi bzhin ras zla ba rgyas pa la/ /byu ru dmar po'i mdangs 'od 'phro ba can/ /spyan gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ltar/ /gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba de la 'dud/ /khyod sku pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar/ /gzengs mtho lhun chags nye ring gar bzhugs kyang / /kun gyi mig sngar sgrib med gsal le ba/ /nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid ldan der 'dud/ /gang gsung so so'i dbang po dang 'tshams par/ /'jam zhing snyan dang sgeg cing dpa' ba'i tshig /sna tshogs gtam gyis kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i/ /dbang sdud gsung gis 'dod pa 'joms der 'dud/ /khyod gsung 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra ji lta'i/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing dri za'i glu dbyangs ltar/ /rab snyan gsung gi gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /nye ring kun gyi rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'dud/ /gang gi thugs ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor ro gcig pa'i/ /'khor 'das kun khyab rang rig ye shes che/ /dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon po ston der 'dud/ /khyod sku gzhan ngor dman la rab brtse zhing / /stobs ldan dregs pa'i snying stobs zhum par mdzad/ /gang thugs gshis lugs kun mkhyen las gzhan pa'i/

/so skye'i blo yi dpag par dka' der 'dud/ /gang gi yon tan mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /brtse bas skal ldan 'gro ba bu bzhin skyong / /nus pas rdzu 'phrul bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs dus kun du ston par mdzad der 'dud/ /'ga' zhig mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan gyis/ /gdul bya 'dul la mchog tu 'dzin mang yang / /skyes mchog khyod kyi zhal dkyil mthong tsam gyis/ /skye 'gro ma lus dbang du sdud der 'dud/ /gang gi grub pa'i mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar gyis/ /gzugs dang gzugs med thams cad bran 'khol zhing / /drag shugs spyod pas ma rung 'dul ba dang / /skal ldan rjes 'dzin 'phrin las mnga' der 'dud/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i las snang tha dad pas/ /mgon po khyod kyi 'phrin las 'jug tshul yang / /de dang 'tshams par ston pa kho bos mthong / /de phyir skyon bral mdzad 'phrin skyong der 'dud/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku bsdu bar mdzad tshe yang / /shab smad dge sdings chos kyi pho brang cher/ /'ja' 'od la sogs ngo mtshar ltas mang dang / /bcas te dag pa'i zhing du gshegs der 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgyal sras kyis brjod ltar/ /bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar bdag 'dra yis/ /bskal ba'i bar du ro 'dzin brgyas brjod kyang / /mi zad gter chen yon tan gter der 'dud/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod/ /bcas rang nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /skye 'phags kyis bsags dge la rjes yi rang / /sna tshogs sprul sku'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /kun kyang mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /de ltar grub pa mchog gi ded dpon che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyod la gsol btab pas/ /bsod nams 'di yi bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub shog

/de la brten nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rab 'phel zhing / /de rgyun bskal par rigs brgyud dri med kyi/ /rgyun du skyong zhing gong nas gong 'phel shog /yod med phyogs lhung bral ba'i lta ba dang / /'dzin med zung du 'jug pa bsgom pa'i rgyun/ /zhen med sgyu ma'i spyod pas legs skyong ba'i/ /'khrul med sa skya'i bzhed gzhung rab rgyas shog /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bstan skyong sbyin bdag bcas/ /thugs mthun thugs kyi thugs bzhed kun 'grub ste/ /bde dang bde mchog bde dpal phun tshogs kyis/ /kun nas kun du kun kyang khyab gyur cig /ces srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing zhes bya ba 'di yang rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs chen po de nyid kyi slob ma'i tha chung sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo nyer drug pa chu pho khyi lo dpal ldan sa skya'i lha khang chen mor lam 'bras bshad pa'i skabs shig rmi lam du 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid lha chen rtse'i mgon khang du chos skyong gur gyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du ma'i dbang bskur rnams dus gcig la stsal ba'i snang ba shin tu gsal ba byung ba'i dus/ 'di lta bu'i gsol 'debs shig rtsom par 'dod kyang le lo'i dbang gis 'gyang pa la/ dus phyis rang lo so gcig lon pa me mo yos kyi lo zla ba bcu pa'i dmar cha'i tshes la shab sgo lnga'i yul ljongs khyad par can dge sdings srin po chos rdzong khams gsum zil gnon du mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal bzhengs pa'i rab gnas mnga' gsol grub pa'i tho rang gi tshe rmi lam du grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid dang mjal te thugs gting nas dges pa'i mdangs bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig mdzad cing /

sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang gi ku ru kul+le'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'di rnams yin no zhes zab chos mang du stsal zhing / /gzhan yang chos tshan 'ga' zhig gnang ba'i mur gnyid sad pa'i rkyen gyi brjed zin la/ yang rgya gar gyi grub chen a bha ya ka ra dang rje sa chen dus mtshungs yin min gyi dogs dpyod sogs gnang ba'i gsal snang khyad par can byung ba'i rkyen byas/ /'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po de nyid 'dra 'dri chos rdzong chen por mgon khang gsar du bzhengs pa la dges pa'i mtshan ma ston par mdzad pa'i yid ches khyad par can rnyed nas/ 'jam mgon rigs kyi bdag po dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad pa rab tu g.yos pa'i rkyen byas dge sdings chos kyi pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob thams cad 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig smras pa/ deng sang yon tan ldan pa'i bla ma dang / /de nyid brjod nus blo ldan slob ma dkon/ /ji ltar ma 'das tshul bzhin brjod pa 'di/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyi yid rab 'phrog byed yin/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung las byung ba'i tshigs bcad do/ /sarba dā oṃ/ mastu sarba wa ga taṃ/ bkra shis/ dge'o// ༈ //bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa rab g.yo zhes bya ba bzhugs/12 dge legs 'phel/ na mo gu ru/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul sku/ khams gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi bla ma/ rnam gsum las lhag yongs 'dzin gang der/ sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyong shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zung shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /nges don khyod sku 'gyur med rdo rje/ /khyod gsung 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung ldan/ /khyod thugs skye med rdo rje'i thugs mnga'/ /rdo rje gsum ldan gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/

/brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /drang don khyod sku ngur smrig gos 'chang / /gsung mchog tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar yid 'phrog /thugs kyi bstan 'gro'i don la gcig gzhol/ /bshes gnyen chen por gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /gang sku mthong tshe lus kyi spu g.yo/ /gang gsung thos tshe dregs pa'i bdud 'joms/ /gang thugs dran pas dngos 'dzin rtsad gcod/ /'brel tshad don ldan gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma/ /ngag dbang sras su bsod nams las bskrun/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig ltar bstan 'dzin/ /grags pas yongs khyab gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal ba gnyis pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rab spras/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa yi bstan pa/ /bzang por rgyas mdzad gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /pad+ma las 'khrungs mtsho skyes rdo rje/ /de nyid snyigs dus bsam bzhin mi yi/ /gzugs su sprul nas 'dul dka' 'dul mdzad/ /bka' drin 'khor med gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan/ /bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag

/'bral med skyongs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ kye ma 'gro mgon bstan pa rin chen/ /'jig la thug tshe mgon khyod byon pa/ /rjes su yid rang da dung de slad/ /bskal brgyar bzhugs pa gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig gnyid gsod mkhyen rab rab yangs/ /brtse bas skyongs shig dmigs med rje ldan bar chad kun bcom rtsal drag mnga' bdag /'bral med zungs shig puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ /bdag kyang 'dren mchog khyed kyi thugs rjes/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin cing / /'chad rtsod rtsom la rtse gcig gzhol bas/ /bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig /rang la nus pa cung zad med kyang / /gzhan dag 'dren zhes ya nga med pa'i/ /blun po bdag la ltos bcas thams cad/ /'dren pa'i gtsug rgyan khyed kyi drongs shig /deng sang 'jig rten khams kyi 'gro rnams/ /nyon mongs rags pas gzhan phyogs pham la/ /rab tu brtson la rgyun mi chad pa'i/ /'khrug long 'di dag zhi bar mdzod cig /kye hud snyigs ma'i chos pa 'di dag /rab tu byung nas nor gsog la brtson/ /thos pa nyung ngu'i rab 'byams par rlom/ /lugs ngan 'di las ldog par mdzod cig /sngags 'chang yin zhes kun la khas len/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo yang mi shes/ /tshig rkyang tsam la bzang por 'dzin pa'i/ /ming btags 'di rnams thugs kyis ma gtong / /bdag ni bslu med khyed kyi nus pas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring bstan pa rab rgyas/ /phyi ma khyed dang 'bral ba med par/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig /'di lta bu'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la de nyid kyi slob bu'i tha chung sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mi phyed pa'i dad pa rab tu g.yos te/ dpal ldan sa skyar shin tu myur bar bris pa 'dis bla ma'i byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yig chung byin rlabs myur 'jug bzhugs/13 na mo gu ru puṇ+ya in+d+ra ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen zhing brtse ba las/ nus mthu gcig bsdus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rigs su bsam bzhin skur bstan pa/ /rigs ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs grags dge sdig blang dor rnam gnyis las/ /dor bya'i yul du gyur pa sdig sgrib dang / /sdug bsngal rtsa ba 'jig rten pa yi chos/ /kun spang bla ma'i༞ zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa rin po che/ /gang de'i sgor zhugs 'chad rtsom rtsod sgo nas/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa dri med kyi/ /rta bdun bla ma'i༞ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma rjes bzung zhing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i gdeng dang rab ldan pas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho bran du 'khol/ /nus ldan bla ma'i༞ phyi ltar 'chad rtsom rtsod kyi bstan 'dzin zhing / /nang du 'khor 'das dbyer med don rtogs nas/ /rtags dang mtshan ma kun gyi mngon du gyur/ /grub chen bla ma'i༞ deng sang 'dzam gling mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /'gran zla dang bral kun gyi skyabs gcig pu/ /puṇ+ya in+d+ra zhes su 'gro la grags/ /'jig bral bla ma'i༞ 'brel tshad don ldan chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /rgyas shing zab pa'i chos kyi char phab te/ /skal ldan nyams rtog 'bras bu smin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma'i༞ de ltar 'dren pa'i gtsug rgyan khyod nyid la/ /dad shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /yid la re ba'i don rnams 'bad med du/ /lhun gyis grub par byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ /bstan pa'i srog shing bdag sogs 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /'gran gyi do med yongs 'dzin dam pa khyed/ /bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan pa dang / /'phrin las yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /mgon po khyod kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /dad ldan bdag gi yongs rdzogs legs nos nas/

/rang gi bsgom dang gzhan la spel ba'i mthus/ /don gnyis mthar phyin spang gnyen 'dre bar shog /de lta'i yon tan mchog dang ma ldan bar/ /lus ngag yid kyi mi mthun phyogs la sogs/ /bar du gcod pa kun las rnam rgyal nas/ /bsam don ma lus 'bad med mthar phyin shog /'khrul zhig dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang / /rgyun chad med par gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /dus 'dir ma zad skye ba thams cad du/ /'dren mchog khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /'di lta bu'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yig chung 'di ni/ sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs la grags pa de nyid kyi mdzad spyod rnam thar dang rang la yang bka' drin 'khor med kyi rgyu mtshan rnams dran nas dad 'dun chen po'i ngang nas dben gnas gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon par shin tu myur bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po grub mchog bsod nams dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/14 /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka sid+dhi shwa ra ma hā mai tri shrī waka gin dra puṇ+ya in+t+ra kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal sa skya pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i mnga' bdag dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis/ /byams pas 'gro ba 'dul phyir dge slong tshul/ /byams pa'i mtshan 'chang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan mthu stobs bsam yas sngags 'chang rje/ /dpal gyi 'byung gnas gang de'i thugs kyi sras/

/dpal 'bar 'phrin las dbang phyug sa skya pa/ /bsod nams dbang po'i༞ ngag dbang dbyangs can mkhyen pa'i cha shas rdzogs/ /ngag dbang legs bshad bsil zer bye ba'i gter/ /ngag dbang lha dang dbyer med sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar son kyang / /bsod nams bya ba'i las la rtag gzhol zhing / /bsod nams 'gro la spel mdzad sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i mkhyen yangs kyis/ /dbang po mchog dman gdul bya skyongs ba la/ /dbang po'i mig dang mtshungs pa'i sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ grags pa'i mchog gyur grub pa'i snyan pa yi/ /grags pa thos pas skal bzang ba spu g.yo/ /grags pa don dang ldan pa'i sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams sprul pa'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku ni gzi brjid 'bar/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gsung mchog tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /mtshan rtog nyer zhi'i thugs ldan sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ dpal ldan srid na che ba'i mi dbang dang / /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa'i yongs 'dzin kun༞ dpal ldan khyod kyi 'bangs gyur sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ bzang po'i rgyun dang ldan pa'i chu gter bzhin/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las rmad byung gting mtha' yas/ /bzang po gang la mnga' ba'i sa skya pa/ /bsod nams༞ de ltar grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba btab pas bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /gtso byas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib dang / /nyes ltung ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /de la brten nas bdag sogs 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub te/ /bstan pa rgyas shing de rgyun bskal ba'i bar/ /rigs brgyud rgyun mi 'chad pas skyong gyur cig /phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig dag pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du skyes nas sa lam rnams/ /mthar phyin gang 'dul sprul pas srid mtha'i bar/

/sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po che grub mchog bsod nams dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyi rang nyid chung ngu'i dus nas spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar 'tsho ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo zhe gsum du son pa na/ gtsang 'brug dus gzing gi nyes med kyi sems can mang po sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa'i tshe/ phan tshun legs spel gyi 'ching lugs bgyis skabs/ yos lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la lho bod mtshams kyi phag ri rnam rgyal dkar po'i bya 'dabs/ sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen bsam 'grub lha khang yangs steng du sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //gsol 'debs nyes pa'i mun sel bzhugs/15 na mo gu ru puṇ+ya in+d+ra ye/ 'dzam gling che dgu kun gyi gtsug phud la/ /zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor lo ngal gsos pa'i/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma sa skya pa/ /'jam dpal dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ /dus mthar dge slong mchog gi tshul bzung ste/ /ma rung gdug pa 'dul ba'i dpa' bo mchog /phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi grub pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar gyi/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun yongs su khyab mdzad pa'i/ /snyan grags skye bo kun gyi kha na rgyu/ /'khrul zhig dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi/ /sngon bsags las ngan dbang las byung ba yi/ /so skye rang la rang dbang med pa'i mthus/

/bgyis dang bgyid 'tshal bgyid la yi rang ba'i/ /lus kyi las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /ngag gi las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /yid kyi las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig /rje btsun bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje yi/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim pa'i skabs der dge sdings chos kyi pho brang gi 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i sku gdung rin po che'i drung du/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can sleb pa'i tshe/ de'i nyin gang hril po 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang sngar gangs can gyi khrod du byung ma srid tsam sogs ngo mtshar yid ches kyi ltas du ma byung ba'i rkyen byas sku gdung gi drung du lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / bla ma rin 'byung gi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs cing / phyag dang maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor brgya phrag du ma nyams su len pa la nan tan snying por bgyis pa'i tshe gsol 'debs 'di yang theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba 'di'i 'phral dang yun du bde legs su gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/16 na mo phyag 'tshal lo bla ma grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/ gu ru kirti ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha drā ye/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal rje btsun sa skya pa/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab cing /

/blo gros bsam pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i mdzad pa rnam dag mchog /bzang po'i spyod pas 'gro ba skyong la 'dud/ /mahā lo tsā bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes/ /yongs grags dpal ldan bla ma bzang po des/ /rnam par sprul zhes 'gro ba yongs la grags/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'khrul pa kun zhig ngag gi dbang po sogs/ /mkhas grub bla ma du mas rjes su bzung / /kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /dpal ldan bla mas lung bstan brnyed la 'dud/ /mgon khyod rim gnyis don la gzhol ba'i tshe/ /rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum tshe dpag med/ /nag po chen po 'od gsal ngang nas gzigs/ /lha yi tshe gzungs gtad pa de la 'dud/ /dus gcig dpal ldan sa skya'i mdun ri'i sner/ /lo dgra gzhom phyir rigs gsum 'debs bzhed de/ /'das dus gong ma'i btab shul btsal ba'i tshe/ /bsrung ma'i sprul pas dngos su bstan la 'dud/ /gzhan yang phyogs mthar 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshe/ /grang ba'i ngad dang ldan pa'i ri bo la/ /drung na gnas pa'i 'khor tshogs skyobs pa'i phyir/ /khor yug drod kyis khyab par mdzad la 'dud/ /mdor na sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin nyid kyi/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar brjod kyi mi lang zhing / /bdag 'dra'i byis pa'i blo yi rtogs dka' bas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag khyod la 'dud/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa skyon gyis ma gos kyang / /bdag cag las ngan bag chags rab 'thug pas/ /dus gsum log lta byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs/ /snying nas 'gyod pa chen pos mthol lo bshags/ /bdag kyang skyon bral gsum ldan la gnas shing / /thos bsam bsgom pas rang gi rgyud sbyangs nas/ /'chad rtsom rtsod la g.yengs ba'i bdud spangs nas/ /spyir gyi bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /khyad par 'khrul med rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dri med yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas nas 'jig rten khams 'di ru/

/bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sems dpa' chen po bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'dren mchog slob bu'i tha chung bdag rgyud la/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /tshul 'di sngags 'chang rje nyid kyis/ /rigs dang chos kyi bur gyur pa/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa yi/ /sgor zhugs skyes stobs shes rab can/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi/ /gong ma'i byin rlabs sa skya yi/ /bzhi thog bla brang mkha' spyod du/ /snying nas dad pa thob de sbyar/ /bla ma so skyer 'dzin pa yis/ /chal chol smras dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /'di las bsod nams gang thob des/ /'gro kun thar pa'i bde thob shog /bdag cag tshe 'di'am 'chi kha'am/ /bar dor 'bras bu smin gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kā l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol 'debs snying gi thig le bzhugs/17 dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa snying gi thig le zhes bya ba/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i gter chen ngag dbang lha/ /rab brtse brtse ba'i bdag nyid 'jig rten mgon/ /mthu stobs stobs ldan gsang bdag dbang po yi/ /rnam sprul sprul pa dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /gang gi skyon med rigs kyi thig le las/ /legs 'khrungs khyim pa'i tshul 'dzin sems dpa' che/ /snyigs dus skye bo gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog de la 'dud/ /mgon khyod dpag med yon tan mdzod mnga' yang / /ngar 'dzin dregs pas nam yang ma gos pa/ /nga nyid bhu su ku zhes dman cha 'dzin/ /'di 'dra'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa bsam bzhin 'dud/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa'i srog shing du/

/mgon khyod 'gyur zhes lung bstan brnyes la 'dud /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos srid kyi/ /dpal 'byor rgyas bya'i mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag kyang / /dus dang 'tshams pa'i thabs mkhas du ma yis/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis skyong ba de la 'dud/ /mdor na dmu rgod 'dul dka'i sems can rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis skyong ba la/ /sems dpa' chen po khyod kyi mdzad pa'i cha/ /gang la bsam kyang snying nas dad pas 'dud/ /kye ma bla ma zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i dus/ /gnyen gyi 'brel pas mi phyed dad ma thob/ /da ni khyod kyi mdzad 'phrin gang bsam kyang / /snying nas sangs rgyas nyid du nges shes skyes/ /nyon mongs bye bas rang rgyud dam bcings pa'i/ /skal ngan bdag la mgon khyod rab brtse bas/ /rmi lam ngang du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /rgyun chad med par bstan pas spro ba 'phel/ /gang sku dran pas mig gi chu g.yo zhing / /gang gsung bsam pas nges shes lhag par rnyed/ /gang thugs byams pa'i rgyun la yid chags pa'i/ /gang la gcig tu dad pa'i slob bu bdag /sngar byas sdig rnams 'gyod sems drag po yi/ /sems dpa' chen po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas mgon khyod mchod/ /'khor 'das dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /brtse ldan khyod kyi nyams dang rmi lam du/ /rgyun chad med par chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /mgon khyod gang la gang 'dul skur sprul pa/ /de kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge ba 'khor gsum yongs dag shes rab kyis/ /bdag gzhan byang chub snying po thob phyir bsngo/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams de yi mthus/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /yongs 'dzin sngags 'chang bla ma khyod lta bur/ /ring por ma thogs bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod pa'i za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan nas lo bzhi lon pa lcags pho sprel lo zla ba dang po'i dus kyi tshe sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid dang rmi lam du snga gong nas yang yang du mjal ba'i tshul rnams dran pa dang /

lhag par lo de yi zla ba dang po'i dus kyang yang yang mjal ba'i rkyen byas nas gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon par yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi snying nas dran pa'i skyo ba dang / rmi lam du yang yang mjal ba'i dga' ba zung 'brel gyi ngang nas sbyar ba 'di'i sngags 'chang bla ma'i thugs kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin bdag gi 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kā l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs/18 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngag dbang kun rin/ /gang gi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu/ sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /khyod kyi sku yi srid gsum zil gnon/ /gsung gi 'gro kun dwangs ba'i dpal bskyed/ /thugs ni bstan 'gro'i don la gcig gzhol/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i/ /yon tan kun gyi gter du gyur kyang / /nga rgyal dregs pas nam yang ma gos/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /dus ngan dbang gi 'khor gyi log sgrub/ /gang la'ang bzod pa'i 'khur dang ldan pas/ /kun gyi sems dpa' chen por mtshan gsol/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan stobs kyis/ /snang srid ma lus dbang du 'dus pa'i/ /grub chen sbas pa'i rnal 'byor mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /khyed kyi ma 'ongs 'di ltar 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan ji bzhin kun gyi mngon gyur/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa de la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /thun mong snang ba'i gzugs sku bsdu tshe/ /dag pa'i 'gro la rdo rje 'dzin khyod/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mngon sum spyan drangs/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /mgon khyod dang por bo dhi sa twa/

/bar du 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ /dus 'dir 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /de phyir khyod kyi ngo mtshar rnam thar/ /bdag 'dras bskal par brjod par mi nus/ /tshul 'di bsam bzhin mi phyed dad pas/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sngags 'chang bla ma/ /khyod kyi mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings nas/ /rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs shig /bdag blo bstan 'gro'i don la gzhol bar/ /sngags 'chang bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par/ /sngags 'chang bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /spyir gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par/ /sngags 'chang bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /khyad par sa skya'i chos srid 'phel bar/ /sngags 'chang bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas/ tshe 'dir bsam don mthar phyin 'grub cing / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye bar/ /sngags 'chang bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa 'di ni lcags spre'u zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum gyi tho rang rmi lam du sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyin gsal bar byon nas zhabs dbu dang bcas pa rang gi mgo thog tu 'jog par mdzad de/ byin rlabs bka' bsgo rgyas par stsal zhing / gzhan yang dges pa'i mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa la rang gi yang gus pa tshad med pa dang bcas thugs rtsa nas ma bor ba'i bslab bya bka' drin che zhes zhus pa snyam byed pa sogs gsal bar byung ba'i rkyen byas sngags 'chang bla ma sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis lha khang chen mo'i shar lho rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas te/

bdag gi bsam don ma lus pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/19 na mo gu ru kirti ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye/ 'dir dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og min chen por zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /'phags pa'i yul du bo dhi sa twa'i mtshan/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sngags 'chang sngon gyi skyes rab gsum la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /thugs kyi sras mchog 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /kun la brtse yang bdag la lhag par du/ /mi mngon dbyings nas skyong mdzad khyed la 'dud/ /phyi ltar sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo can/ /nang ltar rgyal ba rab 'byams 'dus pa'i sku/ /gsang ba rang sems lhan skyes ye shes cher/ /dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon po khyed la 'dud/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du lung bstan brnyes/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /skye 'gro yongs kyi rtsa lag khyed la 'dud/ /mgon khyod zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i tshul bstan kyang / /sras kyi tha chung bdag la thugs brtse bas/ /rgyun chad med par zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /rmi lam ngang du ston mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /lhag par byi lo zla ba bcu pa yi/ /tshes drug tho rangs bzhi thog bla brang du/ /gsal bar byon nas longs spyod dngos grub dang / /phan pa'i bslab bya stsol mdzad khyed la 'dud/ /dam pa khyod kyi zhing 'dir bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /bzhugs pa tsam gyis snang srid dbang du 'dus/

/ci mdzad bstan dang 'gro ba'i don 'gyur ba'i/ /smon lam bzang po mthar phyin khyed la 'dud/ /de ltar sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /sa skya'i bstan pa rin chen 'phel ba yi/ /'gal rkyen mtha' dag rang zhir mdzad du gsol/ /gangs can bde skyid rtsa ba sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud dri med rgyun chad med pa dang / /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /sngags 'chang thugs rje'i gter chen thugs rje yis/ /sa skya'i bka' srung rnams la bka' bsgos nas/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i don 'di bsam pa bzhin/ /sngar bzhin lhun grub 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la byi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes drug gi tho rang rmi lam du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid bzhi thog bla brang gi rab gsal shar ma na bzhugs khri mtho ba zhig gi steng zhal nub tu gzigs nas bzhugs 'dug pa'i sku mdun na rgya ja sogs dngos po mang du 'dug pa la/ nged rang la spyan gyis gzigs nas dgyes pa'i mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad de/ sku mdun gyi dngos po rnams la/ 'di rnams la tho rgyab yod do gsungs nas nged rang la stsal ba snyam byed cing / lhag par sems thog na yod pa'i dogs pa shin tu che ba zhig la 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i bslab bya lhug stsol du gnang byung ba la/ rjes su yi rang ba'i tshig mang du zhus shing / slar yang dus rtag tu thugs brtse bas skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa snyam byed pa'i mod la gnyid sad byung bas/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal por bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad pa snying thag pa nas skyes te/ sngags 'chang bla ma gang de'i sras kyi tha chung a nan+das dpal sa skya'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang gi nyi 'od 'khyil par sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal sa skya pa chen po yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/20 rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ka ma hā man+t+ra dha ra kirti ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga'i mtshan/ /sngags 'chang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab che/ /sngags 'chang thugs kyi sras mchog sa skya pa/ /grags pa blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /grags pa gsal ldan 'khon gyi gdung rigs su/ /grags pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyod byon pas/ /grags pa srid mthar gsal mdzad sa skya pa/ /grags pa blo gros༞ blo gros rab gsal shes bya kun mkhyen zhing / /blo gros zab cing des pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /blo gros gting mtha' yas pa'i sa skya pa/ /grags pa blo gros༞ rgyal ba rab 'byams 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog /rgyal sras mang du spel ba'i dge mtshan gyi/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yab gcig sa skya pa/ /grags pa༞ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku ni zla rgyas bzhin/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i tshangs dbyangs gsung gis mdzes/ /mtshan 'dzin spangs pa'i thugs mnga' sa skya pa/ /grags pa༞ dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa bye ba'i gter/ /dpal ldan nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /dpal ldan skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa/ /grags pa༞ bzang po'i mdzad 'phrin zhi zhing dul ba yis/ /bzang po'i lam la 'gro kun 'god pa'i thugs/ /bzang po gang la mnga' ba'i sa skya pa/ /grags pa༞ bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs kyi sprul sku khyed/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes su'ang mtshan gsol zhing / /bsod nams rgyal mtshan slar byon sa skya pa/ /grags pa༞ de ltar yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /gsol ba btab pas bdag cag dpon slob kyis/

/bcas dang rang bzhin gyis bsdus sdig sgrib dang / /nyes ltung ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /dus 'di nyid du'ang bdag dang slob bu rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /bstan pa rgyas shing de rgyun bskal ba'i bar/ /rigs rgyud rgyun mi 'chad pas skyongs gyur cig /phyi ma bdag cag slob 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /lhan cig bde ba can gyi zhing skyes te/ /'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong gsung thos nas/ /sa lam myur bsgrod rang don mthar phyin shog /slar yang gang la gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed cing / mthong thos dran reg gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /kun kyang dag pa'i zhing du 'dren gyur cig /sngags 'chang yab sras khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /sras dang dbon dang bstan pa'i rgyun la sogs/ /bdag cag brgyud par bcas pa'ang de 'dra bar/ /gyur nas sa skya'i chos srid rgyas gyur cig /'khor 'das snang ba 'gag med sems kyi mdangs/ /dbyings rig rang bzhin med pa sems kyi gshis/ /ngos bzung med kyang nyams su myong ba'i rgyun/ /lhan skyes ye shes rol bar 'char gyur cig /bdag cag so skye rang stobs mthu bral yang / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkhyen brtse nus ldan gyis/ /gzhan stobs dbang gi bdag dang gdul bya yis/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya pa chen po yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu'i 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di yang / rje btsun bka' drin can de nyid kyi chos dang rigs kyi sras su gyur pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi bgrang gzhi zhe gsum du son pa na gtsang 'brug dus gzing gis sems can nyes med mang po sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa'i tshe/

phan tshun legs spel gyi 'ching lugs bgyis skabs/ lho bod mtshams kyi phag ri rnam rgyal dkar po'i bya 'dabs/ sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen bsam grub lha khang gi yang steng du yos lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos 'dod bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs/21 shrī dharmā swā mi bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra nirmā ṇa ya na maḥ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gtsug rgyan mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mthong bas yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i sku/ /thos pas gdung sel yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /ji lta ji snyed chos kun mkhyen pa'i thugs /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa khyed la 'dud/ /grangs med thos pa rgya mtshos rgyud phyug cing / /bsam pas ji bzhin nges pa'i don gzigs nas/ /tshul bzhin bsgoms pas 'khor 'das ro gcig rtogs/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dri med gzhung brgya 'chad la thogs med pa/ /legs bshad rtsom la kun gyi snyeng dang bral/ /'gal dang ma 'brel spyod la ma rmongs pas/ /yongs 'dzin kun gyi zhabs zung bsnyen la 'dud/ /thog med dus nas las dkar spyad pa'i mthus/ /dus 'dir mgon po khyod kyi rnam thar la/ /mi phyed dad pa thob pa'i skal ldan rnams/ /bu gcig lta bur skyong la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa khyod ni dang por rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha'i mtshan/
