/dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /kun gyi 'gran zla bral la kun nas 'dud/ /rab mdzes baiḍūr+ya yi 'dzin ma'i dbus/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub khri yi steng / /chu skyes pad+mo'i gnyen dang bsil zer gyi/ /gdan bzhugs yon tan 'byung gnas khyod la 'dud/ /gang gi phung po lnga ni rigs lnga ste/ /de kun 'dus pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /khams lnga rig ma tshigs rnams khro bo bcu/ /skye mched byang sems lha mo'i ngo bor 'dud/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun rang bzhin khyod kyi sku/ /gang gsung dam chos khyod thugs rkang gnyis gtso/ /yon tan nor lha 'phrin las chos skyong ste/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas lhub grub rtsa dang yi ge khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gdan gsum tshangs ba la/ /dbang bzhi stsal nas sku lnga thob mdzad pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /rtse gcig gus pas yid kyi phyag 'tshal zhing / /yid gnyis spangs te mchod pa kun gyi mchod/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /'phags bzhi so skye'i dge la rjes yi rang / /gnas lnga'i chos 'khor rtag tu bskor bar bskul/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i don du rtag bzhugs zhes/ /nor bdun ldan pa'i rje btsun khyod nyid la/ /chos brgyad g.yo zol min par gsol ba 'debs/ /sa dgu'i bsdus pa'i mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang ma thob bar /rnam 'dren khyod kyi byams pa'i phyag zung gis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyabs du gsol/ /khyad par bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya rnams/ /skye zhing skye ba kun du chos kyi rje/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /zab don sgom la gcig tu brtson par shog /de la brten nas yul chen so gnyis kyi/ /rtsa dang dbu ma'i mdud pa rnam grol nas/ /gnas dang nye gnas la sogs rim bgrod de/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod rtogs pa mngon gyur shog

/de tshe dus gsum bde gshegs bcud 'dus kyi/ /dbang gi 'gros bzhi thim nas rten brten pa/ /gnas gyur sku lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang / /che ba gsum ldan de nyid myur thob shog /gus pas bstod cing smon lam btab pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang de'i 'gro drug kun/ /kun mkhyen sa skya'i bzhed gzhung rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'dir phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas gyur cig /ces drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos 'dod bsam 'phel zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po dang ldan pa/ shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ a na la zhes pa me pho 'brug gi lo/ dza la dā ga ma: zhes pa sprin 'byung gi zla ba dang po'i nyer dgu'i nyin dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur bris pa'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/22 rgya gar skad du/ pa de wa dza ga ta nan+ta s+yā tsa tu ḍa ma ṇi nam+pī the ṣu pā da yu ga s+yā bi krī ṭi na ya ka wa ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na mo/ /bod skad du/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtsug gi nor bu'i khri la zhabs zung gi rnam par rtsen pa'i 'dren mchog sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /dngos grub gter chen rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mtshan ldan chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun bud+dha'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum 'gro ba srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dus mthar mi yi gzugs/ /theg gsum zab rgyas chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/

/dus gsum mkhyen pa khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /smra mkhas mkhas pa kun gyi rgyan gcig pu/ /rje btsun btsun pa'i mchog gyur yongs kyi skyabs/ /spyod bzang bzang po'i mdzad pa 'gran bral ba'i/ /yongs 'dzin 'dzin pa'i rgyan gyur khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gang gang rtogs par dka' ba gsung rab don/ /de de mkhas dang grub pa'i srol bzhin du/ /rang rang gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa ltar/ /yang yang tshim par mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rab brtse brtse ba'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs stobs ldan gsang ba'i bdag dang mtshungs/ /'dren mchog mchog gsum ngo bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal sras mchog gyur mgon khyod kyi/ /bu slob bu ltar brtse bas legs bskyangs te/ /bde mchog bde blag stsol ba'i bka' drin can/ /ma lus ma ltar mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i sku/ chos kyi gsung dbyangs gsungs pa rdo rje'i gsung / /snyems ma'i bdag po bdag nyid rdo rje'i thugs/ /kun gyis bstod la bstod cing mgos phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag bstan la lhag par rab dad pa/ /bskal par las dkar mang bsags gang dag rnams/ zag pa bag chags bcas pa spangs mdzad pa/ /dam pa gang la bdag phyag dwangs bas 'tshal/ /nyid kyi rim gnyis ting 'dzin ji bzhin rig /nges legs bde chen ye shes dge legs spel/ /dus kun rgyun du sku gsum lhun du grub/ /dkon mchog ngo bo mgon po khyod bstod do/ /de ltar bstod pas dad ldan slob bu bdag /da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /dus gsum gzigs pa khyed dang mi 'bral zhing / /don gnyis lhun grub bstan pa 'phel bar shog /ngan song gsum sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /nges 'byung drag pos dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /ngo mtshar dri med lam la rab brtson pas/ /nges legs 'bras bu'i nyams rtog gong 'phel shog

/yang yang snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /ye nas lhun grub sku lnga rdo rje 'chang / /yongs grags de nyid myur du mngon gyur te/ /yang dag lam gyi 'gro kun sgrol bar shog /ces 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar ut+pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras gyi bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ me mo sbrul gyi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la legs par sbyar ba 'dis shu bhaṃ skye dgu thams cad bde legs su gyur cig mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ smras pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /rtse gcig 'dun pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di/ /sngon byon skyes chen dam pa kun gyi srol/ /deng dus kho bo'i spyod yul las gzhan gang / /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa byin rlabs bde chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/23 rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka saṅgu ru dharmā swa mi badz+ra a tsar+ya mahā gu ṇa rat+na ka ra: bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na ma: bod skad du/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje rdo rje slob dpon chen po yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku mchog /theg gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin/ /mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan bla mar/ /sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /gang sku kun khyab tshul khrims dri ldan/ /gang gsung sgrib gnyis sel ba'i stobs mnga'/ gang thugs bde stong chen po'i rol pa/ /gang gis 'gran med gsol ba 'debs so/ /mgon khyod dang por kun mkhyen sangs rgyas/

/bar du 'jam dbyangs bud+dha rat+na/ /dus 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /mchog tu 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs so/ /grangs med thos pas thugs rgyud legs bltams/ /bsam pas ji bzhin nges pa'i don gzigs/ /tshul bzhin bsgoms pas dngos 'dzin rtsad gcod/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gsol ba 'debs so/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa nam mkha' ltar yangs/ /brtse bas dmigs med 'gro ba yongs khyab/ /nus pas nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur mdzad/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan gsol ba 'debs so/ /gzhung brgya 'chad la thogs med blo rgyas/ /lung rigs 'gal 'brel rtsod la rab mkhas/ /sdebs legs rtsom pa'i ded dpon chen por/ /kun gyis 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gdod nas lhun grub dkyil 'khor bzhi la/ /dbang bzhi stsal nas lam bzhi bsgoms pas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu thob par mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs so/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yum lnga'i bdag nyid /khro bo byang sems lha mo kun 'dus/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngo bo khyod la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /sku gsung thugs rnams dkon mchog gsum dngos/ /yon tan nor lha 'phrin las chos skyong / skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ /khyod la snying nas gsol ba 'debs so/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi 'dus sku/ /rab bsags skal ldan yongs kyi bla ma/ /rab mang thabs mkhas 'gro ba skyong la/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /de dus gangs can khrod 'dir mkhas btsun/ /bzang gsum ldan pa'i 'dren pa nga zhes/ /dregs pa'i sgra skad 'byin pa kun gyi/ /gtsug rgyan gcig pur gsol ba 'debs so/ /de ltar rdo rje 'chang chen khyod la/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ /yid la re ba'i bsam don 'di dag /'bad med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /'dir snang grags bde'i zar zir dag la/ zhen pa chod de thos bsam sgom dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bde gshegs bstan pa/

/yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod cig /yongs 'dzin khyed kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i theg pa'i/ /spyi dang bye brag nyams len thams cad/ /ji bzhin rgyud la 'byor bar mdzod cig /khyad par bla med rdo rje theg pa'i/ /rim gnyis don la gcig tu gzhol bas/ /yul chen so gnyis rtsa mdud grol te/ /ye shes chen po thob par mdzod cig /de'i tshe bde gshegs bcud 'dus dbang gis/ /'gros bzhi thim nas rten dang brten pa/ /gnas gyur sku lnga rdo rje 'chang chen/ /gsum ldan de nyid mngon gyur mdzod cig /mdor na sha khrag gdos bcas lus 'di/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub cing / /rang sems dbyings rig ro gcig gyur nas/ /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyeg par mdzod cig /gal te sngon bsags las ngan dbang gis/ /kye hud lus sems 'bral bar gyur kyang / /dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las rgyal te/ /don gnyis 'bad med mthar phyin mdzod cig /'chi tshe 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs ba med pa'i/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i yang dben dam par/ /dus rnams rtag tu zab don bsgom la/ /rtse gcig skyo ngal med par mdzod cig /dus der bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi/ /zhal gzigs lung bstan byin gyis brlabs nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba la sogs/ /dag snang 'ba' zhig 'char bar mdzod cig /ci ste de 'dra'i skal ba med kyang / /'chi ba'i dbugs nyid brtsegs pa'i rkyen gyis/ /las rlung nang log khyab byed gtso bor/ /rgyus tshe bye ba phrag phyed bzhi yi/ /rtsa phran nyid kyi rlung dang byang sems/ /stong phrag bdun cu'i rtsa yi 'phrogs pas/ /dbugs rgod rtsa mdud grol ba'i zug gzer/ /byung tshe rang ngo shes par mdzod cig /stong phrag bdun cu'i rtsa yi stobs kyang / /'khor lo 'brel ba'i brgya dang nyi shu'i/ /'phrogs shing de yang yul chen nyi shu/ /rtsa bzhi rtsa dang snying kha'i phyogs kyi/

/rtsa 'dab brgyad kyis 'phrogs pa'i dbang gis/ /rlung rnams yan lag dag la lhung bas/ /sor mo re'ang lci yor byed tshe/ /rten 'brel de dag shes par mdzod cig /sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi stobs kyang / /ro rkyang gis 'phrogs shin tu dbugs rgod/ /de gnyis stobs kyang dbu mas 'phrogs te/ /sa chu me rlung rim bzhin thim pa'i/ /rtags su dbang po'i sgo rnams gsher zhing / /kha sna skam dang skyags bu mang byung / /zug gzer drag po byung ba'i dus der/ /rim bzhin rang ngo shes par mdzod cig /rlung nyid rnam par shes la thim tshe/ /snang mched thob dang 'od gsal rnam bzhi/ /de dag rim bzhin shar ba'i dus su/ /de der rang ngo shes par mdzod cig /du ba 'tshub dang zla ba shar 'dra'i/ /snang ba'i phyi nang rtags gnyis shar te/ /'dod chags rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags nas/ /de rjes me khyer nyi ma shar 'dra'i/ /mched pa'i phyi nang rtags gnyis shar tshe/ /zhe sdang rtog pa sum cu 'gag cing / /de nas nang rtags mar me 'bar dang / /phyi rtags nag lam sgra gcan lta bu'i/ /thob pa'i rtags gnyis shar ba'i dus der/ /gti mug rtog pa bdun dag 'gags te/ /der rjes 'od gsal chen po shar tshe/ /skya rang shar dang nam mkha' sprin bral/ /lta bu'i dus der 'od gsal ma bu/ /gcig tu 'dres nas grub mtha' snyog pa'am/ /dpe yi ye shes skye bar mdzod cig /der yang 'bras bu'i skal ba med na/ dmyal ba dud 'gro 'dod khams yi dwags/ /gnod sbyin mi dang mi'am ci dang / gzugs khams gzugs med lha yi skye sgo/ /bshang gci lto ba kha dang sna bug /mig dang rna ba mdzod spu spyi gtsug /sgo rnams dag nas tha mal ngang nas/ /'phos pa min pa tshangs pa'i lam nas/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi thugs kar/ /'phos nas dbyer med ro gcig gyur te/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la sogs/ /skad cig nyid la thob par mdzod cig /gal te rnam shes bar dor 'khyam tshe/

/shi bar ma shes gnyen grogs dag dang / /'grogs par bsam yang lan med yid chad/ /de tshe chags sdang chod par mdzod cig /phyed dang bzhi yi phyi ma phan chad/ /rang nyid shi ba yin par shes te/ /yi mug mgon dang skyabs gnas 'tshol dus/ /rang rig skyabs su shes par mdzod cig /gdos bcas dang bral dbang po kun tshangs/ /lha dang bla ma byin rlabs can sogs/ /ma gtogs kun la thogs med bgrod cing / /bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum skor sogs/ /dbang med bya sgro rlung khyer lta bu'i/ /dus der kun kyang sgyu mar shes shing / /rang sems rang dbang thob par mdzod cig /'byung bzhi'i rlung rnams 'khrugs pa'i rkyen gyis/ /ri bo grum dang rgya mtsho rab 'chol/ /nags tshal bsreg dang dus mtha'i rlung chen/ /lang pa lta bu'i sgra bzhin byung tshe/ /so sor rang ngo shes par mdzod cig /kha dog lnga ldan 'od zer 'khrug cing / /'od dang thig le thig phran tshogs las/ 'jigs pa'i khro tshogs rgyob sod sgra dbyangs/ sgrog cing nyon mongs dug gsum dbang gis/ /dkar dmar nag pa'i gcong g.yang che la/ /rang nyid lhung snyam rab tu 'jigs shing / /gnas dang rten dang grogs dang kha zas/ /spyod lam rnam shes yid yul rnams la/ /nges pa med pa'i rtags rnams shar tshe/ /'khrul snang dran pas zin par mdzod cig /dus der dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams dag tu/ skye ba'i snga ltas 'od lam kha dog /nag ser dkar dmar ljang dang sna tshogs/ /snang ba shar tshe rang sgo shes shing / /khang bzang nags tshal rin chen gzhal yas/ /pho mo sbyor dang rgya mtsho chen po/ /ngang pa rta glang pho mos brgyan dang / /sdong dum 'phyar bag lo ma'i spyil po/ /sa phug la sogs de dag mthong nas/ /gnas der 'bros pa'i snang ba shar tshe/ /skyes gnas ngan par shes par mdzod cig /nyi zla mi gsal mun pa'i gnas su/ /de lta'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs shar tshe/ /'jigs shing skyo ba'i snying rlung lang dus/

/de tshe phyi dang nang dang gsang ba/ /mthar thug ston mdzad mgon khyod dran te/ /de la brten nas lam dang lta ba/ /gsang ba'i ming rnams dran pa'i mod la/ /ma dag snang ba'i 'khrul snang de kun/ /lhag pa'i lha yi rol par shar te/ /snang sems thams cad ro gcig gyur nas/ /bla ma lha yi lung bstan byin rlabs/ /thob nas brtan pa zin par mdzod cig /mdor na bdag gi dal 'byor lan gcig /thob pa'i dus 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i/ /dri med lam la rab tu brtson zhing / /gegs med rgyud la 'byor bar mdzod cig /de la brten pa'i tshe 'di'i 'chi kha'am/ /bar dor don gyi 'bras bu smin nas/ /phyin chad las dang nyon mongs dbang gis/ /skye sgo ngan pa chod par mdzod cig /de lta'i yon tan ma ldan bar du/ /rang nyid nam 'chi gar skye med pa'i/ /blun po bdag la ltos bcas thams cad/ /'dren pa'i gtsug rgyan khyod kyi drongs shig /mi phyed dad ldan slob bu bdag cag /byang chub bar du rdo rje 'chang chen/ /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan khyod dang / /skad cig 'bral ba med par mdzod cig /ces pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa'i 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa'i de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ a na la'i lo/ sha ra da'i dus kyi/ rgod ma can gyi zla ba'i bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o/ /'dis rang gzhan la mchog tu phan par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bstod pa snyan dngags gi 'khor lo ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/24

baṭ+ṭa ra ka dharmā sā mi ye na ma: 'dir smras pa/ thos bsam bsgom pas mngon rtogs yon tan brnyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa zla ltar spel/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mus pa chen po rgyal/ /mgon po de la bstod pa snyan ngag gi /'khor lo ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya 'di/ /mang du thos pa'i dge slong sa skya pa/ /ā nan+da yis 'bad de legs par bkod/ /tshul 'di klog par 'dod pa'i dpyod ldan rnams/ /re mig dbus kyi yi ge 'gyur med la/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi phyi rim g.yas bskor bklag /de nas bcu gsum phreng rnams dkyus bzhin bklag /'di la dbus kyi re mig bcu gsum gyi/ /yi ge de dag klog tshul zung ldan no/ /de ltar bklags pas rje btsun bla ma yi/ /mtshan gyi phreng ba nyer gcig 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan gang de'i mtshan/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod la'ang bsod nams tshogs/ /grangs med bgrangs ba'i yul las 'das 'byung ba/ /nges pa'i shes pa skyes nas tshul 'di sbyar/ /yang dag bstan la lhag par rab dad pa/ /bskal par las dkar mang bsags gang dag rnams/ /zag pa bag chags bcas pa spangs mdzad pa/ /dam pa gang la bdag cag dwangs bas 'tshal/ /nyid kyis rim gnyis ting 'dzin ji bzhin rig /nges legs bde chen ye shes dge legs spel/ /dus kun rgyun du sku gsum lhun grub tu/ /dkon mchog ngo bo mgon po khyod bstod do/ /legs bshad smra mkhas mkhas pa kun gyi rgyan/ /yongs 'dzin rje btsun btsun pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /spyod bzang bzang po'i mdzad pa rmad byung ba'i/ /'dzam gling sa 'dzin 'dzin ma'i rgyan der 'dud/ /dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen khyod/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /sku gsum gdul bya'i snang brnyan rtag bzhugs la/ /sgo gsum sgrib gnyis dri ma sbyang du gsol/

/zhes rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bstod pa snyan ngag gi 'khor lo ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po de nyid kyi bka' drin las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bu'i shes rgyud bltams pa'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ me mo sbrul gyi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la gtsang stod rgyal po'i pho brang gi sa'i cha bsam rtse brang mo cher legs par sbyar ba 'dis kal+yā na war+dhan+tu/ ma ma puṇ+yā dz+nyā na shrī bhu mi ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ mahā mu tra sa ra ma sid+dhi prasta ku ru/ sarba su kha bha wan+tu// // na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ya ā+oṃ 'chad mkhas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas bstan pa'i log rtog rtsod spel mkhas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyas sogs 'phrin las skyong mkhas pa mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyal ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas sku rgyal tshab sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan mtshan gyi rab rgyas bde ba ster mkhas mchog sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan thos bsam rgyal ltar mtha' ru phyin ded dpon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan mangs mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan kun mkhyen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan sangs smras legs bzang mkhyen 'dren mchog sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan mangs mtshan ldan pa kun gyi bdag rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan mkhan slob rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong rgyal sras sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan mtshan de zhi rgyas dbang drag bdag yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyal ba'i bstan la sangs rgyas bzhin bsgom mkhas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rgyas pa'i lung rig rab mkhas mchog smra mkhas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas dges pa'i legs bshad rtsom rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa bsam don kun 'grub bzhugs so/25 /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ mdo rgyud man ngag kun rig thams cad mkhyen/ /sdom gsum nyes pa'i dri bral btsun pa'i mchog

/rim gnyis ting 'dzin gyis grol grub dbang rje/ /rje btsun mus pa'i rnam thar bsam bzhin dad/ /yongs 'dzin khyed la bdag 'dra'i slob ma'i tshogs/ /rnam grangs mang pos ljongs 'di khyab gyur kyang / /bdag cag kho na spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar/ /gces par bskyangs pa'i bka' drin dran pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi spu ldang mig nas mchi ma 'khrug /snying nas bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis/ /rgyun du mtshan nas 'bod cing gsol 'debs na/ /mi mngon dbyings nas 'bral med thugs rjes skyong / /zhes bya 'di yang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bla ma dran pa'i skad cig la/ /bris 'dis bsam don kun 'grub shog /sarba dā oṃ// ༈ //bla ma mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/26 na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bslu med dam pa gang gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gtsug rgyan mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar mdzad pa'i tshul/ /cung zad dran la'ang byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char/ /rgyun chad med par stsol ba'i mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas༞ 'khrungs ma thag nas rgyal sras rig sad cing / /bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rang tshangs rig/ngo mtshar gzhon nu'i sar bzhugs mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan༞ rdo rje 'chang dngos yongs 'dzin du ma las/ /skyon med sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin sogs/ /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyal mtshan༞ mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos rgya mtsho la/

/brtson pas thos bsam sbyangs pas sgro 'dogs chod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtsug rgyan mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan༞ yengs med ting 'dzin sgrub la gcig gzhol bas/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyan gyur mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan༞ mtshon byed dpe dang rtse mo'i ye shes brnyes/ /ma 'ongs mkhyen sogs grub pa'i sar bzhugs pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mus pa rje/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan༞ gang la gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo che/ /rtag par bskor bas bstan 'dzin slob bu yi/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab pa'i mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal༞ gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /mkha' spyod dbang mos mngon sum spyan drangs te/ /rtags bzang kun la ston mdzad mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal༞ de ltar bla ma'i yon tan cha shas tsam/ /brjod pa'i dge bas yongs 'dzin dam pa dang / /byang chub bar du 'bral ba med do zhes/ /zhal bzhes ji bzhin gegs med don ldan shog /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i khur chen khyer ba dang / /de nyid ngal ba 'bras med ma yin pa/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas byed pa'i/ /sprul pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun chad med pa dang / /kun kyang 'phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par shog /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /skyes nas bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang / /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin par shog /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyang / /bdag gi rjes bzung thar pa'i bde thob shog /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

/log par 'dren pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/ /ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan kyi zhabs la yan lag mchog gi reg cing / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms par 'thung bas rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar can rnams la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngar nas byas pa'i gsol 'debs rnams kyi tshig ha cang mang ches pa nas blo gros zhan pa rnams 'dzin 'don dka' ba la bsam nas nyung gsal go bde'i rang bzhin gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di bya lo zla ba lnga pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog blang brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu// ༈ //rje bla ma mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dad pa'i myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/27 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /bdag gi 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gcig pu/ /rje btsun mus pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gro kun rjes su zung / /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin stsol/ /ces pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shin tu myur bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ//

༈ //rje rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya bzhugs so/28 /na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na maḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba rje btsun gcig chog rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje 'og min gnas su rdo rje 'chang / /gnas 'phags pa'i yul du zas gtsang sras /ljongs gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mus pa che/ /rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs nges 'byung tshul khrims rnam dag pas/ /dgag sgrub gnang gsum la mkhas shing gzhol/ /tshul khrims dri bsung gis phyogs kun khyab/ /rje 'dul ba pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg chen sems bskyed kyis rgyud bltams pas/ /gzhan gnod kyi bsam pa dug bzhin spangs/ /phar phyin dang dbu ma'i gzhung kun mkhyen/ /rje ka dam+ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /spros bral gyi lta ba'i phu thag chod/ /mi phod thog brdzis kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'byung po stobs ldan kun dam la btags/ /rje gcod yul ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams la/ /thos bsam nyams len kun mthar phyin pas/ /tshe 'das kyi byang bu dngos su 'gul/ /rje yo ga ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs kyi gsal snang bde drod 'bar/ /gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod pha mthar son/ mkha' spyod du 'pho bas mngon sum gshegs/ /rje bde mchog pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /thun bzhi yi lam la byang chub pas/ /sgrub khang lha dgu'i gzhas yas su gzigs /ye shes kyi 'jug ldog khor mo yug /rje lam 'bras pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs brgya dang rigs gcig gi rnal 'byor 'byongs/ /rdor bzlas dang dben gsum mtha' ru phyin/ /sgyu lus dang 'od gsal zung 'jug brnyes/ /rje gsang 'dus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/

/sngon byon gyi grub chen bud+dha shrī/ bzhin/ /bde kye yi lam la rab gzhol bas/ /sbyor drug gi nyams rtags thams cad rdzogs/ /rje dus 'khor ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor ngang nyid nas/ /bla ma dang dag pa'i zhing kun mjal/ /mtshon byed kyi dpe yi ye shes brnyes/ /rje ne gu ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang grag rig gsum gyi chos 'di kun/ /lha sngags ye shes su rtag gzigs pas/ /bka' srung chos skyong rnams bran bzhin 'khol/ /rje mthu rtsal gyi mnga' bdag la gsol ba 'debs/ /pha bla ma bskyangs pa'i gces phrug bdag /pha bla mas dran pa'i skad cig la/ /pha bla mar gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs thal/ /pha bla mas mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs/ /rje khyed la gcig tu yid gtad pa'i/ /mi bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /dus 'di la tshe ring nad med cing / /yid bsam don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bdag gis spel ba'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /'di rigs brgyud gtsang mas rtag skyong zhing / /bdag dpon slob phyi mar lhan cig par/ /zhing bde ba can du skye bar shog /rje skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /mgon khyed la rtag tu gsol 'debs kyis/ /bdag slob mar bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /ces rgyal ba mus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di yang rje bla ma dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo so dgu lon pa shing phag zla ba bcu pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tho rangs kyi cha zhig rje bla ma'i yon tan dran pa'i mod la thol byung du gsol ba btab pa'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/

/'di sbyar dge bas khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs brtse ba chen pos skad cig kyang 'bral ba med par bdag cag dpon slob rnams rjes su bzung nas 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub du 'byung bar gyur cig /ka l+yā na wartu shu bham̐// ༈ //bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs su bcad pa snying gi gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/29 rgya gar skad du/ sarba bi dz+nyā na lo ka tsak+ṣu tsakri nā thā bud+dha dh+wa dza s+ya ban+dha ni kā ro mi/ bod skad du/ thams cad rnam par mkhyen pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig 'khor lo'i mgon po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin te/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun ldan pa/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan nges bud+dha'i mtshan/ /dag pa'i zhing nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /kye ma kye hud rje btsun mus pa rje/ /bsnyun bral sprul sku snyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /'pho med thugs rje 'pho ba'i ngang tshul gyi/ /dus kyi nges pa dang bcas dus mthar bzhugs/ /kye hud 'jig rten stong so chos kyi rje/ /yin bzhin nor bu brnyed nas glo bur stor/ /dad can skye bo thams cad mig dang bral/ /de ring 'jig rten thams cad mun par song / rigs gzugs phun tshogs tshul khrims lus zung rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba kun mkhyen pa'i/ /mang thos gang de lo 'ga' mi bzhugs pa/ /bstan pa'i bya ba bshol nas gang du gshegs/ /bgrang yas blo gsal rgyu skar phreng ba yis/ /'khor yug mdzes pa'i kun gsal chos kyi grwar/ /gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i snang ba mi stsol bar/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zla ba ci slad gshegs/ /yang dag lung gi rta bdun dang 'grogs nas/ /rig pa'i 'od zer bye ba rab bkye nas/ /log lta'i mun pa stug po dpyis 'byin pa'i/ /bsnyengs bral bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir yol/

/mtha' yas 'gro la bu gcig ltar dgongs shing / /byams dang snying rjes gzhan dbang gyur pa khyod/ /da dung 'gro ba'i don mang ma rdzogs na /mgon me bdag cag 'dor ba 'di phod dam/ /khyod kyis sngon chad 'gro 'di bde bar bskyangs/ /da ni khyod dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyi/ /zug rngu drag po'i lus sems sdug bsngal ba'i/ /'khur 'di thar 'dod rnams kyi steng du lhung / /snang ba lha dang 'khor lo'i rnam rol te/ /de yang bde stong mchog gi rang bzhin zhes/ /mgon po khyed kyis bdag la bka' stsal nas/ /nyams thag sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ci slad stsol/ /kun gyi mig la bdud rtsi stsol mkhas pa'i/ /grangs med bsod nams phung po 'dus pa'i dngos/ /yid 'phrog rdo rje'i sku yang gzhan yin na/ /skye bo bden pa'i yid brtan su la bgyi/ /dad pas khyod kyi zhabs drung gnas byas nas/ /'dzum zhal yang yang blta bas ma ngom pa/ /da ni yud tsam mthong ba'i skabs bral ba'i/ /bdag gi mig gi bsod nams gang du song / /rgyud lung man ngag phyogs re'i snang ba can/ /bshes gnyen rgyu skar 'char nub mang na yang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gling bzhi gsal nus pa'i/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub po chos kyi rje/ /rgya chen chos kyi mdzad pas thugs drangs nas/ /yang yang phyag gi zur phud la bkod pa'i/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rin chen bzhi/ /glegs bam tshogs rnams grogs med skyo ba 'phel/ zab don bla ma'i zhal la rag las pa'i/ /rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas su yi 'byed/ /bde gsang rgyud sde'i zab gnad su la 'dri/ /theg dman theg chen gzhung don gang nas btsal/ /chos min spyod pas nam yang ma gos pa/ /'di ni bdag cag lha yi bla ma zhes/ /lha bu rnams kyi me tog gis bsus te/ /snum gtsang lha yi lam nas yud kyi gshegs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan nyams dus 'dir/ /chos kyi chab srid skyong bar mi mdzad par/

/'ja' 'od shing rta chibs nas khyed gshegs pa/ /'di bas don che gzhan zhig gzigs lags sam/ /bgrangs yas yon tan du mas mdzes pa'i sku/ /'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya ston pa'i gsung / /mtho dman kun la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' khyod/ /da ni dran pa tsam gyi yul du gyur/ /de phyir skal ngan bdag la tshe 'di ru/ /sngar bzhin dngos su mjal ba'i skal med kyang / /nyams dang rmi lam la sogs dag snang la/ /'dren mchog khyed kyi zhal dkyil bstan du gsol/ /phyi nang bar chad thams cad bsal du gsol/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bskyed du gsol/ /bsam don mthar phyin bstan pa 'phel ba dang / /'chi tshe mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol/ /bdag la snying nas dad pa'i slob bu rnams/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /chos med bdag 'dra'i skyobs par ma nus pas/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed kyis skyabs su gsol/ /mdor na bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya yi/ /gtso byas pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /rje btsun khyod kyi drung du skye bar shog /ces bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs su bcad pa snying gi gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzin ma'i khyon yongs su khyab pa de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gi gsung rab las legs bshad kyi cha blang la tshig ring 'ga' zhig bcos shing kha skongs cung zad dang bcas te/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa de nyid sa pho rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi nam langs tsam la gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad de/ sgra dang /

'od dang / me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'da' kha ma zab mo gsal 'debs par mdzad nas dbu gtsug tshang pa'i bu ga nas mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du thogs pa med par gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa nas bzung zhag zla shel dbang gi grangs brgya phrag gnyis don pa mgo zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gcig sngon slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs nyid dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par bsdebs pa 'di'i bdag gi rgyud la khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bla ma la brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/30 na mo bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i nus mthu kun/ /gcig bsdus snyigs ma'i dus kyi bstan pa yi/ /rgyal mtshan g.yo med 'dzin pa'i mus pa rje/ /bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /rab mdzes ngur smrig gos gyon brjid pa'i sku/ /skal ldan nye lam ston mdzad snyan pa'i gsung / /'khor 'das dbyer med thugs mnga' mus pa rje/ /bskal brgya'i༞ rje btsun khyed kyi rnam thar thos pa thag /dad ldan bdag gi ba spu gting nas g.yos/ /tshe rab du ma'i bla ma mus pa rje/ /bskal brgya'i༞ mkhyen brtse nus ldan yongs 'dzin khyed nyid kyis/ /skal ldan bdag rgyud smin grol lam la bkod/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mus pa rje/ /bskal brgya'i༞ bslu med dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang / /'dzam gling 'gro ba'i rnam dkar nus mthu yi/ /bstan pa'i srog shing rje btsun mus pa rje/ /bskal brgya'i༞ bdag kyang sdom pa gsum la legs gnas shing /

/rgyal ba'i bka' dang gong ma'i gsung rab la/ /thos pa spyod cing bsam pas go ba dang / /de don ji bzhin rgyud la 'byor bar shog /lhag par bla med theg pa'i rim gnyis la/ /g.yeng med rtse gcig gzhol ba'i nus mthu las/ ma dag snang kun dag pa rab 'byams su/ /rgyun chad med par rtag tu snang bar shog /khyad par rdzogs rim nyams len mthar phyin te/ /'khor 'das rang gi sems su ngo shes shing / /de yang skye ba med par thag chod de/ /snang stong zung 'jug dus kun 'da' bar shog /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab pa dang / /'dren mchog bla ma khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ /bstan dang 'gro la bde skyid 'phel ba'i phyir/ /bsam don 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /'di lta bu'i brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu po 'di ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa gang der snying nas dad pa thob pa/ sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad 'dun chen pos kun nas blang ste/ gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon par myur bar sbyar ba'o/ /'di bgyis dge bas rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad yun ring brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs ma dad pa'i dpal ster zhes bya bzhugs/31 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan de nyid dgung lo don gsum bzhes shing / bdag rang lo bco brgyad lon pa'i dus gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos grwa zur du zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin mu mtha' med pa zhig stsal ba'i dus su chos gsha' ma byed pa la dka' spyad dang / blo thag nang nas chod pa dgos tshul rgyas par gsungs pa'i 'phros la/

sngon gyi bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi 'di bzhin mdzad pa yin zhes kha rag sgom chung pa dang / po to ba'i rnam thar 'di ltar yang gsungs te/ sngon gyi dus su slob dpon rin chen gsal ba dang / gtsang kha rag bsgom chung gnyis mched grogs yin pa la/ dus nam zhig 'phan yul brag rgyab tu dgon pa ya tshad ma tshad la dge sbyor byed kyi yod pa las kha rag sgom chung gis mtshams bcad nas bsgom pas/ dge bshes po to pa'i thugs la/ thos pa tsam ma byas pa'i sgom 'di ma legs te/ nga la chos cig nyan nas bsgom na nor du 'gro bas snyam pa dang / khong rang gi grwa pa rnams la yang chos gsungs res kyi lung pa'i phu ya gi na sgom chen rmongs pa cig yod ces zur za dang bka' bkyon kyi rnam pa dus rgyun du mdzad pa la/ dus nam zhig na khong gnyis chos ston cig la 'tshogs pas/ dge bshes rin chen gsal gyis co 'dri thabs su/ kha rag pa la khyed kyis de tsam bsgom pas nyams rtogs ci skyes/ thugs la ci shar dris pas kha rag pa na re/ bdag gis dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pas tshe 'di la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bsgom pas 'dod yod la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ gang du skyes kyang skyid med par bsgom pas 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sems bskyed bsgom pas rang gcig pu'i bde ba dang thar pa la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ chos thams cad rang bzhin skye ba med par bsgom pas gzung 'dzin gnyis la blo ldog dgos par go lags/ zhes gsungs pas/ dge bshes thugs mnyes nas sngar ma gus pa la 'gyod pa skyes bzod gsol byas ste/ da nga la khyed rang gi thugs la dgongs pa'i gdams ngag yi ge'i rigs su bris pa cig zhu 'tshal gsungs pas/ kha rag bzhengs nas dgon par bzhud pa dang /

dpon slob rnams dgon pa'i sa yul der nye bar phebs pa'i tshe/ de'i mtha' skor gyi rtswa rnams nyal phyogs thibs se ba dang bcas mi sogs kyi rgyu 'grul byung ba'i rjes gtan nas mi 'dug pa po to bas gzigs pas 'jigs chum pa zhig byung zhing / de nas rim par byon pas sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsigs nas/ shar gyi tho la/ nyams chung bdag la rkyen ngan gnod pa mang / /brtan pa thob nas byang chub grogs su 'char/ /nags kyi me dang me stag ji bzhin du/ /gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i dbyar dam yin/ /lhor/ 'chi bdag bdud ni mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong / /de la thar ba'i thabs ni gcig kyang med/ /da lta gnyid dang le lo'i dbang song nas/ /ci 'dra'i dus shig bdag la nam 'ong na/ /nub tu/ tshe 'di'i lto rgyab ji ltar byas kyang phyid/ /shi nas 'bras bu byang chub btsal thabs med/ /dgra zin sde rigs kun la ma chags par/ /bsod nams chen po myur du bsags pa gces/ /byang gi tho la/ tshe 'di long med tha snyad thug pa med /de phyir dam pa'i dgongs pa longs mdzod la/ /'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dgon pa nyams dga' der/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur gnas par bya/ /sgo'i ya them la/ so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags kyang / /chos pa 'khyags sam ltogs nas shi ba dag /sus kyang mthong zhing thos pa cang yod dam/ /phyin chad du yang mthong zhing thos mi 'gyur/ /ma them la/ snying ring bka' blo mi bde rang 'dod che/ /zag pa 'phel ba'i 'khor g.yog med na legs/ /nga yi nye gnas shes rab brtson 'grus yin/ /dgos pa'i don rnams bsgrub la skyo ngal med/ /ces pa 'dug pas shin tu mnyes/ de nas nang du byon pas rna ba la sogs ri dgas kyi tshogs mang du 'dug pa la/ de rnams kha rag pa'i sku la lces ldag cing gus 'dud byed pa dang / po to ba la 'jigs snang gis bros 'gro ba gzigs pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ kha rag pas bdag gi skye ba lnga brgyar sha ma zos pa dang /

byams snying rje 'dra bsgom pas yin gsungs ba la/ po to ba'i gsung gis byams snying rje tsam bdag gis kyang bsgom blo byas pa yin te zhes gsungs shing thugs zhum par gyur/ /de nas kha rag pa'i gsung las/ de ring dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba byon pas lto skyid cig byed pa yin zer nas zan chang par ba'i sbugs su bcug pas yas su mi snyug mas su mi snyug pa zhig dang / lo ma'i dum bu nyung zad cig bzhes/ rgyun par gtso cher dka' thub la bzhugs pa yin par gda'/ /de nas kha rag pas ang yig bdun cu ma sogs kyi gdams pa gnang te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba khong rang gi dgon par byon/ de phyin chad chos gnang res bzhin dgon pa ya gi na bsgom chen bzang po nged kyi chos bshad pa 'di thams cad khong gis nyams su blangs pa zhig yod pa yin gsungs bstod bkur bsngags gsum kho na mdzad pa zhig byung bar gda'/ zhes pa 'di ni bdag gi bla ma 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi gsung las yang yang du byon pa rang gi blo la ji ltar zin pa bzhin/ rje de nyid kyi spyan ras kyi bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sug bris bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' can gyis bgyis so/ /'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ //rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'chi med dbang po'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs/32 oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'chi med dbang po'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ bla ma rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ut+pal sngo ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlas brjod bye ba'i pha mthar son/

/sa skyong kun gyi zhabs la gtugs/ /gang gi mtshan grags bstan pa'i rgyan/ /bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sa skya'i sde dang bstan pa'i khur/ /ngal ba lhur bzhes sems dpa' che/ /ci mdzad bstan 'gro'i don 'gyur ba'i/ /grags pa blo gros zhabs la 'dud/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /da lta mkha' spyod gnas na bzhugs/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /rje btsun mus pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyes bu dam pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan/ /rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga ba/ /kun dga' don grub zhabs la 'dud/ /gcig tu bsgrub la brtson mdzad pa'i/ /ngang nas gzhan don lhun gyi grub/ /btsun zhing bzang po'i yon tan ldan/ /sbyin pa grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gsan pa bye ba'i thugs rgyud gtams/ /zab bzhes 'bum sde'i nor gyis phyug /snyan brgyud bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs la 'dud/ /shes bya ma lus thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyun du ting 'dzin sgrub la gzhol/ /deng sang bstan 'dzin kun gyi rgyan/ /ngag dbang chos grags zhabs la 'dud/ /gzhan yang zhal mjal gsum thos shing / /zab mo'i chos kyi 'brel ba yi/ /yongs su grags min bka' drin can/ /bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /khyed rnams tha mal skur mthong ba/ /rang sems gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'di/ /glo bur dri mas sgrib phyir te/ /de phyir log lta ci bgyis bshags/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa khyed rnams kyi/ /rjes 'brangs slob bu'i tha chung bdag /gzhon nu'i dus kyi bsam pa la/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs thos bsam dag /ngoms med spyad de gangs khrod 'dir/ /mi tshe 'chad nyan sgrub pa la/ /dril nas spyi dang bye brag gis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gzung snyam pa'i/ /sems bskyed mi dman tsam mchis kyang / /rang gi sngon bsags las kyi mthus/ /da ni dpal ldan sa skya yis/ /lugs gnyis 'khur gyis lus sems mnar/

/'di 'dra be'u'i phrag pa ru/ /glang chen 'khur po lhung ba ltar/ /bla ma gong ma sangs rgyas kyi/ /mdzad 'phrin bdag 'dra so skye yi/ /skyong zhes khyongs bar 'dod pa mtshar/ /'on kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed rnams kyi/ /re smon 'di rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing gnas pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob tshe ring zhing / /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa dang / /de rgyun ji srid bskal pa'i bar/ /rigs brgyud dri ma med pa yi/ /rgyun chad med par legs bskyangs ste/ /'phral dang yun gyi 'dod pa'i don/ /kun kyang 'bad med lhun grub mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /phyi ma lhan cig zhing gi mchog /bde ba can du legs skyes nas/ /slar yang sprul pas bstan 'dzin mdzod/ /ces rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'chi med dbang po'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po rje btsun mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ snyan brgyud gdam pa'i gter chen chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa la sogs te yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa du ma'i zhabs sen rin po che dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba 'dis/

/bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos mgyogs par bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kal+yā na war+dhan+tu/ sarba dā oṃ// ༈ //rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/33 na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'jam dbyangs mched dang rgyal ba mus pa che/ /spyan snga rin chen nags dgon sbyin pa grags/ /dbang phyug rab brtan ngag dbang chos grags la/ /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin stsol/ /zhes rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa sngags 'chang chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang nyid kyi rgyun pa'i kha 'don gyi slad du sug bris bgyis pa 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub mchog stsol bzhugs/34 na mo gu ru sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub yongs kyi mgon/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin ltar 'byed mkhas pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i gser gyi khri steng du/ /dri med rab mdzes sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba kun kyi skyabs gcig pu/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dri med lha yi rigs 'khrungs mdzes pa'i sku/ /dri med tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i gsung / /dri med thugs kyi bdag sogs 'gro ba skyong / /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun khyod nyid la/ /bdag sogs snying nas dad pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob mdzad pa'i/

/bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /don med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /'jig rten phyogs la snying po med gzigs nas/ /'khrul zhig spyod pas skal ldan dwangs ba 'dren/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de ltar 'gro mgon 'jam dbyangs bla ma la/ /snying nas dran pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas/ /g.yel ba med par thugs rjes bzung nas kyang / /myur du rnam mkhyen 'bras bu thob par shog /sngar bzhin nyin re bzhin du rje btsun gyi/ /sku mchog mthong dang gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /sgrib pa kun sbyangs tshogs mchog rdzogs pa sogs/ /legs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong 'phel rnams/ /re zhig bar du 'byung bar mi nus kyang / /rje btsun rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /dkar phyogs rgyal zhing nag phyogs pham pa'i mthus/ /slar yang dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /myur du mjal zhing chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun nyid la sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /sku tshe ring zhing 'phrin las rgyal pa'i mthus/ /rgyal bstan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ /bde skyid 'phel zhing chos la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni 'khon gyi rigs can shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid rje bla ma de nyid mdo khams smad kyi phyogs la gdul byar byon dus yang dang yang du bla ma nyid dran pa'i rkyen byas te legs par sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni kun dga' don grub kyis bgyis so/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dkon mchog gi bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
